jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK.

Role Summary

PLOS is a nonprofit Open Access publisher with an ambitious mission: to help transform research communication so that science can be shared, understood and used more effectively.

Research publishing is changing rapidly. Researchers' expectations are changing. Technology is creating possibilities that didn't exist a few years ago. And at PLOS we're rethinking some of the services, systems and assumptions that have shaped scholarly publishing for decades.

That means there are interesting product problems to solve - not just features to deliver.

You'll take responsibility for a product area and work with designers, engineers and colleagues across PLOS to understand the problems that matter, work out where we can make the greatest difference and help the team learn its way towards good solutions.

You'll be joining active product teams working on significant problems and will have plenty of opportunity to shape what we do and how we do it.

How we work

We want our product teams to be curious, evidence-led and comfortable with uncertainty.

We don't expect a Product Manager to arrive with all the answers. We do expect them to ask good questions.

You'll use continuous discovery alongside delivery: spending time with users, looking at data, understanding the wider service, identifying assumptions and finding practical ways to test them.

You'll help the team break large problems into smaller things we can learn from, rather than waiting until everything is known before we release something.

And you'll make the team's thinking visible - explaining what we're trying to achieve, what we've learned, what we're uncertain about and why we're making the choices we are.

Responsibilities

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll:

  • Understand the problem.

jobs.title: Senior Propulsion Engineer - Combustion Devices (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Mission Brief

You will be a senior technical contributor within Combustion Devices, responsible for high-fidelity combustion CFD and the physical understanding required to design, assess and mature liquid rocket engine combustion hardware. You will apply reactive-flow simulation, combustion fundamentals and test correlation to injectors, preburners, gas generators, ignition systems and main combustion chambers, ensuring that designs are performant, stable, thermally robust and ready for manufacture and hot-fire testing.

Your Role in Our Space Mission:

  • Own and execute CFD analyses of reacting flows in liquid rocket engine combustion devices, from model definition and meshing through solution, verification, validation and technical recommendation.
  • Develop and apply premixed, partially premixed and non-premixed combustion models for rocket-relevant propellant systems and operating conditions.
  • Perform steady and transient RANS/URANS and, where justified, scale-resolving simulations such as LES to investigate mixing, ignition, flame stabilisation, combustion efficiency and unsteady heat release.
  • Model injector and chamber flows including atomisation, evaporation, multiphase effects, real-gas behaviour, conjugate heat transfer and wall heat flux where relevant to the design question.
  • Assess combustion stability and operability, including flame dynamics, pressure oscillations, injector coupling, acoustic interaction, chugging and high-frequency instability risks.

jobs.title: QC Inspector (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Mission Brief

As QC Inspector, you are responsible for verifying that incoming materials, manufactured parts, assemblies, and released products conform to drawings, specifications, workmanship standards, and quality requirements. You will perform dimensional and visual inspections, review supplier documentation, record objective evidence, and support reliable conformity decisions throughout incoming and final inspection.

This role is critical to protecting product quality and production continuity. You will work closely with Incoming Inspection, Production, Metrology, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Engineering, and Product Assurance to identify non-conformances, improve inspection methods, and ensure only compliant hardware progresses through the manufacturing flow.

  • Conduct dimensional inspections using hand gauges, measurement equipment, microscopes, and coordinate measurement systems as applicable.
  • Perform visual and workmanship inspections, including verification of surface condition, coating, cleaning, marking, damage, and assembly quality.
  • Review certificates of conformity, inspection reports, material certificates, and other supplier quality documentation for completeness and compliance.
  • Record inspection results and maintain accurate, traceable quality and product acceptance documentation.
  • Identify, segregate, and report non-conforming products and support technical clarification, containment, and disposition activities.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement, standardization, and quality-at-source initiatives across manufacturing operations.

  • Completed technical vocational training in quality inspection, machining, mechanics, mechatronics, metrology, or a comparable technical discipline.

jobs.title: Founding Engineer (gn) – Hardware & Bioengineering, Munich
jobs.description:
About Cellsor

Cameras digitized vision. Microphones digitized sound. Smell is the one major sense we still can't capture, measure or transmit reliably. Cellsor is building the sensor that changes that.

We replicate the mammalian olfactory epithelium outside the body – living olfactory tissue on microelectrode arrays – and read it out with machine learning. The result is a sensor that detects chemicals the way a nose does, with the breadth and sensitivity that conventional gas sensors lack. Applications span flavor and fragrance, defense and security, medical diagnostics, food quality and industrial monitoring.

We are a VC-backed Tufts University spin-out with a working proof of principle and paid industry pilots, with teams in Boston (biology) and Munich (engineering).

About the role

As our first engineer in Munich, you develop the instrument that keeps our living sensor tissue alive and samples the air it analyzes. You take it from today's lab setup to a field-ready prototype at a customer site within 18 months.

What you will do:

Define the instrument architecture, then build prototypes across mechanics, fluidics and housing

Develop automated media exchange that keeps cells viable for weeks to months

Build the air path: sampling, filtration and controlled delivery of odorants to the sensor

Integrate sensors, pumps and controllers for monitoring and automation

Test and iterate with our Boston biology team

Contribute to grant applications

What you need to succeed

Must-have:

MSc or PhD in mechanical, biomedical or bioengineering, or a related field

Built a lab or medical device from concept to working prototype

CAD, rapid prototyping, and electronics integration

Comfortable with uncertainty: you make progress without a defined path and decide what to build next

Hands-on and self-directed – you'd rather test an idea on the bench than discuss it for a week

Fluent English; German a plus

Nice-to-have:

Cell culture, perfusion or microfluidics

Gas handling or air sampling

Startup or grant-funded R&D experience

Why join Cellsor now

Cellsor is an early-stage, VC-backed deep-tech startup, funded to focus on building. Most hardware roles mean optimizing one part of an existing product. Here you build the first instrument for a new category of sensor, and your design decisions become the foundation of the platform. The technical risk has moved from "does this work?" to "how do we build it for the field?" – which is exactly where an engineer makes the difference. As the platform grows into electrode integration, machine learning and product design, so does the scope of your role.

What we offer

Equity in Cellsor, so you share in the value you help create

The opportunity to build and lead the Munich engineering team as we grow

Real responsibility from day one, working directly with the founders and technical advisors

Lab and workspace at UnternehmerTUM, with regular exchange with our Boston team

About Shiftbase

We build workforce software that helps people get work done. More than 10,000 companies use our platform every month to plan shifts and track time, with less admin in the way.

We work from our Zoetermeer office with over 80 people and we grow every year. The culture is open and informal. You can push back on an idea regardless of title, and we change how we work when someone makes the case in retro.

About the role

You build frontend features that customers use the day you release them. You sit in a product team with backend, QA, design and product, and you take a feature from a rough product idea to a screen a planner can use without a manual.

Your time is a balance between working on features, bugs and resolving technical debt.

First, ship.

Deliver features in scheduling and time tracking. Start small, then take one full feature from the product conversation through to release.

Then, own an area.

Pick up a product surface end to end and become the person the team asks about it, including what it should do next. That covers how AI fits your area, which patterns you document for the agent and which calls you keep for yourself.

Along the way, make what you build safe to change.

Fix bugs in your own features and in code you've never seen

Improve the code you touch while you touch it, so the next feature in that area costs less

Write and maintain automated tests in Jest and Playwright

Ship in short cycles with your product team

Pair, review, and teach what you know

Frontend in Angular, backend in PHP, a web app and a mobile app in React Native. Tests in Jest and Playwright. We develop AI-assisted with Claude Code as the primary tool, and a growing share of our code starts there. Human

Talk360 connects more than 6 million people across 190 countries. How they find us is changing fast: Search is moving from blue links to AI generated answers and paid and organic increasingly shape each other. A missed opportunity here isn't just a lower ROAS number. It's someone staying connected with family abroad, a business trying to reach a supplier, or someone who urgently needs to reach a real phone number.

As our Senior Acquisition Marketeer, you won't own a channel. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
De wereld om ons heen verandert razendsnel. Wat vandaag nieuw is, kan morgen alweer achterhaald zijn. Bij PuurData krijg je de kans om samen met collega’s te werken aan slimme oplossingen voor onze klanten. Zo kun je bijvoorbeeld bedrijven helpen met het inzichtelijk maken van hun data of meedenken over hoe ze veiliger met hun data om kunnen gaan. Je helpt onze klanten vooruit door ze mee te nemen in nieuwe technologieën en te laten zien waar bijvoorbeeld AI daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegt. Op deze manier kun je zowel kleine, maar ook grote en veeleisende bedrijven helpen met oplossingen die kritisch zijn voor hun bedrijfsvoering.

Tenslotte zorgen wij er samen voor dat jij continu blijft groeien en op de hoogte bent van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Data Engineer bij PuurData ben je meer dan een technicus. Je bent een consultant die klanten helpt om meer waarde uit hun data te halen. PuurData werkt met platformen zoals Elastic en AWS, en bedient klanten op het gebied van zoektechnologie, observability, security en AI. Jij bent degene die die oplossingen tot leven brengt.

Je start bij de klant. Je inventariseert de vraag: wat willen ze met hun data? Gaat het om betere zoekfunctionaliteit, real-time inzicht in systemen, of security en threat detection? Klanten weten vaak dat er iets niet klopt. Data is traag, er is geen inzicht, of er zijn performance problemen. Maar ze weten niet altijd hoe ze het moeten oplossen. Jij helpt dat helder te maken.

Vervolgens ga je samen met de klant naar de juiste oplossing toe. Je vertaalt de behoefte naar een concrete aanpak en implementeert die van A tot Z: van het inrichten van de datastroom tot het opleveren van dashboards en inzichten.

Geen dag is hetzelfde. De use cases lopen uiteen van zoekoplossingen en business process monitoring tot SIEM-implementaties en data engineering-pipelines. Dat geeft je veel vrijheid in de invulling van je werk.

Continu leren is geen optie, maar de norm

Technologie staat niet stil, en jij ook niet. Bij PuurData is training verplicht. Je blijft op de hoogte van de laatste ontwikkelingen, denk aan Elastic, AI-integraties en nieuwe dataplatformen, en past die kennis direct toe in klantprojecten.

Je bent een ondernemende professional die weinig sturing nodig heeft. Je ontwerpt, bouwt en beheert ETL- en ELT-workflows die meegroeien met het aantal klanten.

Bij Squla combineer je technologie, spel en kinderpsychologie om digitale leerervaringen te ontwerpen die de wereld van kinderen vergroot. Squla helpt basisschoolkinderen leren door middel van games, quizzen en interactieve oefeningen die aansluiten op het Nederlandse onderwijs. Met onze productvernieuwing bouwen we aan de volgende fase van Squla. Jij helpt ontdekken welke leerervaringen daarin het verschil kunnen maken.

Bij Squla werk je aan vragen als: Hoe help je een kind na een fout weer op weg? Wat maakt een oefening uitdagend zonder frustrerend te worden? Hoe zorg ik dat de vorm bijdraagt aan het leereffect?

Je spreekt kinderen, ouders en leerkrachten, bezoekt scholen en combineert observaties met gedrags- en gebruiksdata.

32-40 uur

Wil jij jouw analytische talent inzetten voor logistieke vraagstukken met directe impact? Bij BERG hebben we meerdere stageplekken binnen Logistiek & Supply Chain. Je werkt aan een concrete opdracht waarmee je onze logistieke processen verder professionaliseert en krijgt volop ruimte om jouw eigen ideeën en oplossingen te ontwikkelen.

Of je nu enthousiast wordt van logistieke optimalisatie en containerbelading of juist van transportdata, benchmarking en dashboards: bij BERG is er ruimte voor jouw talent.

Create your

future

Als stagiair(e) Logistiek & Supply Chain werk je bij BERG aan een logistiek vraagstuk met directe impact op onze internationale supply chain. We hebben meerdere stageplekken, waarbij je afhankelijk van jouw interesse aan de slag gaat met één van onze twee opdrachten.  Interesse in logistieke optimalisatie? Dan ontwikkel je een  Container Load & Capacity Optimizer . Je onderzoekt hoe we onze containerruimte beter kunnen benutten en ontwikkelt op basis van onder andere SKU’s, afmetingen, gewichten en laadrestricties een praktische tool die de optimale belading en benodigde capaciteit berekent.  Ligt jouw interesse meer bij transport, data en dashboards? Dan ontwikkel je een  Transport Benchmark & Selectie Dashboard . Je analyseert offertes van pakket- en palletvervoerders en maakt tarieven, toeslagen, gewichtsklassen, landen en serviceniveaus inzichtelijk. Met scenarioanalyses en een dashboard help je BERG om transporteurs beter te vergelijken en besparingsmogelijkheden te ontdekken.  Bij beide opdrachten werk je met data, Excel en mogelijk AI en is er volop ruimte voor jouw eigen ideeën. Je werkt samen met logistieke collega’s en zorgt ervoor dat jouw oplossing niet alleen goed werkt, maar ook daadwerkelijk binnen BERG gebruikt kan worden.

100%

you

Voor beide stageopdrachten zoeken we studenten die analytisch sterk zijn en graag een complex logistiek vraagstuk vertalen naar een praktische oplossing.

• Je volgt een hbo-opleiding in Logistiek, Supply Chain Management, Technische Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting.
• Je hebt sterk analytisch en wiskundig inzicht.
• Je werkt nauwkeurig, gestructureerd, kritisch en zelfstandig.
• Je vindt het leuk om data te analyseren en hiermee tot concrete oplossingen te komen.
• Je hebt affiniteit met Excel, data-analyse, dashboards en/of AI-toepassingen.
• Je bent praktisch en bedrijfsmatig ingesteld en betrekt gebruikers actief bij jouw oplossing.

What’s in it for

you?

Je krijgt de kans om mee te werken aan concrete logistieke vraagstukken binnen een internationaal merk en oplossingen te ontwikkelen die écht gebruikt worden binnen BERG. Je draait mee met ervaren logistieke collega’s en krijgt zo de kans om veel te leren over supply chain, transport, data en optimalisatie.  Je krijgt veel vrijheid om te experimenteren, je eigen ideeën in te brengen en écht impact te maken op onze logistieke processen.

jobs.title: Co-Founder & CTO (gn), Industrial Data for AI, Paris
jobs.description:
About FoodLabs

FoodLabs is Europe's leading early-stage VC and venture studio, backing founders who are shaping the future of the food, health, and climate value chains. We build companies from zero, putting capital, our own team, and hands-on operating time behind a founding team before there's a product or even a name. The studio's work spans wherever a market and the data or infrastructure underneath it are broken enough to justify building the fix from scratch.

About The General Data Corporation

General Data

is the infrastructure for licensing proprietary data: The platform runs the whole deal from request to delivery, with privacy checks, rights evidence and contracts built in. The vision is to become the system of record between AI and the world’s private data, the data that has never been published but that the next generation of AI depends on. On one side are enterprises, AI labs and robotics teams that need real-world data, and on the other are companies whose operations generate it. General Data is the data infrastructure for the modern economy, connecting every party so that data can be licensed safely, transparently and at scale.

Why this is a unique opportunity

AI has absorbed the public internet, and its next gains will come from private, real-world data, yet today these deals still run on email, WhatsApp and brokers, with no visibility into what was checked, who holds the rights, or whether personal data was removed. Labs are already paying for this data, and regulation like GDPR and the EU Data Act makes a trusted, verifiable layer a necessity.

General Data is VC-backed and looking for its technical co-founder. Together with Founder & CEO

Louai Allani

, you will own the product and architecture, shape the company’s direction as an equal partner and build the team from the ground up.

Supplier intake:

Build connectors for where companies actually keep their data: Databases, document stores, ticketing systems, machine logs, and sensor and video archives.

Transaction layer:

Own the pipeline, rights evidence, contracts, permissions, audit trail and delivery API.

ML and data quality:

Build anonymisation across text, tables, images and video, plus re-identification checks, deduplication, quality scoring and tooling that turns raw records into training-ready data.

Delivery and compute:

Decide whether data is processed in our cloud or inside the supplier’s environment. Build secure delivery, recurring updates and our GPU infrastructure.

Technical direction:

Own the architecture and roadmap. Work directly with labs, suppliers and researchers to understand what the system needs to become.

What you need to succeed

Data infrastructure at scale:

You have built pipelines for large unstructured datasets, such as video, images, sensor logs or documents, at terabyte scale or more.

Physical-world data:

You have worked with documents, logs, video or sensor streams, ideally in robotics, industrial or autonomous

jobs.description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

AI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there; knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up.  Frontier labs naturally put their own models first. Companies often follow suit, asking one general-purpose model to handle ten very different jobs. We believe there is far more to unlock in the models that already exist, even before the next generation arrives. That is the opportunity we are building around.  We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the result against agreed quality standards. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the right combination for the task.  Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one.  Our founder brings considerable drive, a hands-on approach and a strong sense of urgency to building the company. Backed by Atlantic at pre-seed, we are growing the engineering team to bring the product into production, with people already waiting to use it.

Working directly with the founder, CTO and founding AI engineer, you will help turn early architectural decisions into systems that remain reliable as the product grows.  You will take capabilities from design through to production, thinking through their APIs, failure modes, deployment, observability and ongoing operation. Bleu Robotics is an AI company developing universal AI software for the deployment of advanced robots , humanoids, mobile manipulators, and industrial arms, in real factories. The convergence of humanoid robotics and modern AI is one of the most significant technical opportunities of the decade, and most of the work today still happens in research settings. This objective shapes our roadmap and every technical decision we make.

THE ROLE

The platform will let customers run our learning pipelines on their own data as a hosted service; its exact scope will evolve with the product.  You will be the first engineer at Bleu Robotics with cloud expertise. The scope covers infrastructure, training and inference services, the web front end, security, and cost. software or ML platform engineer who has built and operated a cloud service that runs training or inference jobs on data uploaded by users (e.g., an ML platform team, an MLOps product, a SaaS that runs compute on customer data).

backend or full-stack engineer with solid DevOps experience who has shipped a web product on a major cloud provider and wants to work on robot learning.

Experience with robotics or robot learning is appreciated but not required. You will learn the learning stack from the team; the team will learn cloud practices from you.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Design the architecture of the platform and select the cloud provider, orchestration layer, and web stack, in agreement with the team

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
About Kernel  Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at  Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout  already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 5x YoY.

The Role

You'll be a player-coach engineering leader with a spike in technical strategy, you'll own engineering delivery for your team end-to-end - from developing exceptional engineers to solving some of our most difficult engineering problems & setting technical direction.  This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll spend roughly 20% of your time contributing code and 80% leading your team, with that ratio shifting as we scale.

Build, hire, and develop a high-performing engineering team

Help set technical direction and architecture decisions

Work with the engineering to tackle some of our most difficult problems

Collaborate closely with Product on roadmap and prioritisation

We are in the unique situation that our commercial traction is ahead of our product. You’ll play a leading role in moving towards automation in a way that enables us to rapidly scale with increased complexity and specific customer nuances.

You have extensive experience in architecting enterprise-level systems, delivering on ambitious product visions, and building world class engineering teams.

You have worked at high-growth businesses, and might have previously started your own company.

You are highly analytical, and thinking proactively through the implications of your decisions, but also have high conviction and understand the importance of moving at pace and shipping often.

Limbic’s vision is to ensure the highest quality therapy is accessible to everyone, everywhere.  Limbic has supported more than 820,000 patients across the UK and the US. jobs.title: Special Projects Lead - Category Expansion
jobs.description:
Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain?  The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual and broken.  Fleek is fixing this.  Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice.  We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it.  Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion that can grade, price and categorise items with just a photo. Turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable and tradable global inventory layer.  Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates.  Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally.  We're looking for people who want to build something that matters and move fast doing it. Sounds good? Keep reading.

About the Role  We're hiring a Special Projects Lead to take Fleek's new category bets from thesis to proven economics. Each is a new business line that could add £5M+ in GMV, opening a new supply category or a new sourcing geography for the marketplace. Here's what makes these bets unusually winnable. Fleek already owns the demand. Most of the live bets sell to buyers who transact on Fleek today, so they're a supply-first test rather than a two-sided cold start. Your job on a new bet is to find and onboard the supply, sell it into demand that already exists and read the economics fast.  Every bet runs through the same gates. If a bet misses its gates, you kill it with evidence and move to the next one. If it works and you're running it well, you don't have to hand it off. You scale into owning the category, with supply, acquisition and ops building out under you. Think of this seat as a venture builder inside Fleek.  One thing this is not. We're not building a sales team or a sales culture, and this is not an AE or account manager role with a new title. You'll work directly with the founders and our commercial lead, close to the centre of the company.

What You'll Do

Run bets through the gates:  take each bet from market research to first suppliers to first GMV to a feasible-or-not call, with win metrics and kill metrics defined before y

About OLIX

AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry is still leaning on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. A new paradigm that is faster and more efficient will be the biggest economic opportunity of the next century and create the most important company of the next decade. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect enables a step change in system level performance.

The Role

The Talent Director owns how OLIX finds, wins and hires the people who will build it. Hiring them is a precision problem, not a volume one. You will build a team of recruiters as sharp as the engineers they hire, and set an AI strategy for recruiting that changes how we decide, not just how fast we work. The best argument wins here, and we expect you to make it, welcome challenges to it, and change your mind when the evidence says so.

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve market leading prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want to grow their businesses profitably. There is significant work to do across all three, with scope to add new dealer solutions over time.  This is a senior commercial leadership role. Herausforderungen, mit denen wir uns gerade beschäftigen:

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Web + Infrastructure)
jobs.description:
Searoutes makes the emissions data that shippers use to run and reduce their
logistics. It is an operational problem before it is an environmental one, and
in our hands it is mostly an engineering one.

We are hiring a  senior engineer  who works across our web frontend and our
infrastructure — the same two codebases, in the same week. Someone who ships a
product screen on Monday, changes an identity-provider flow on Wednesday, and
considers those the same job.

We are looking for a broad profile rather than a specialist. The next year is
mostly platform work with a user-facing edge —  user management, API gateway

management, payments, SEO, and a great deal of compliance, GDPR and ISO 27001.

If you are passionate about the environment, proactive and pragmatic in getting
things done, and love to work in a complex but fascinating industry where you
learn every day — then this is the place for you.

The work in front of us

Some of the items on our tech roadmap for the coming year. Bets are picked a
cycle at a time and shared out, so you would take the ones that suit you and
grow into the rest.

Product and marketing UI in React  — multi-brand, WCAG AA, strong on
technical SEO, fast enough to hold a performance budget.

User management and identity  — Keycloak realms, organisation hierarchies,
partner brokering, and the entitlement model in the app.

API gateway work in APISIX  — routes, plugins and auth policy as code.

Payments and billing.

ISO 27001 and GDPR  — access control, change management, audit logging,
observability and alerting, consent and retention.

The infrastructure underneath  — Pulumi in TypeScript, Docker Swarm on
Hetzner, Cloudflare at the edge, Tailscale for all engineer and CI access.

Third-party integrations  — usually the seam between two systems that were
never designed to meet.

Nobody arrives fluent in all of that, and we are not expecting it. We want
someone strong across a good part of it, comfortable being new to the rest, and
used to working things out — with a team and with agents, rather than alone.

Also in daily use: Postgres and PostGIS, Valkey, ClickHouse; Vite, Tailwind and
Radix; Jest and Playwright; GitHub Actions; HAProxy. Most of what we write is
TypeScript, strict — though our core API is Java and Spring, and the identity
layer has Java in it too, so how far you go into that side is up to you.

How we work

LLM-native, in the codebases you would work in.  They are built around
agent-assisted development rather than merely tolerant of it — the conventions,
the tooling and the review gates all assume it. Agents do most of the
implementation and much of the review; humans design, verify and approve. What
we are really hiring for is  judgement over output you did not write by hand :
knowing what to specify, what to check, and what to throw away. The bar did not
move when the tooling did.

Shape Up, and you own what you take.  Roughly three weeks of building, then a
week of cooldown, with bets chosen at a b

Unsere Produkte, zum Beispiel unsere Waschstreifen, machen Waschen und Putzen leichter. Ohne schwere Flaschen, ohne Schnickschnack.  Ein gutes Produkt allein reicht aber nicht. Warum bleibt jemand beim Scrollen bei uns hängen? Welcher Trend passt zu bluu und welcher nicht? Warum funktioniert ein Creative diese Woche und nächste Woche nicht mehr? Und wie wird aus einem Like eine Bestellung, in der Schweiz und bald auch in Europa?

Genau dafür suchen wir dich. 
Wir holen Content und Creative gerade ins Haus. Meta läuft seit August bei uns statt bei einer Agentur. This role is part of our  ScraperAPI  team, one of our growing brands at  saas.group .

ScraperAPI is an enterprise-scale web scraping solution, trusted by businesses across a wide range of industries to extract crucial data at scale. From e-commerce, travel to real estate and market research, we support companies in turning the web into actionable insights. We're currently on an exciting growth journey, scaling rapidly as demand for reliable, high-performance web scraping and data keeps rising.

Profile Overview

This is the hard end of web scraping. The sites we rely on, Google, Amazon, Walmart and many others, actively work to block us, and they change the rules without warning. We're looking for a senior engineer who can go deep on why we're being blocked, work out how the detection actually functions, and design repeatable ways around it. You'll be joining a self-driven, high-autonomy team to take on our most involved problems, with the room and the trust to build something from close to a blank page: an environment that turns one-off breakthroughs into a methodical, repeatable way of defeating anti-bot systems. If you like confronting problems that genuinely resist you, and you work methodically rather than by trial and error, this is an unusually open brief.

Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be:

Getting a full local environment running and becoming fluent in our systems and how they operate, in the first few weeks.

Contributing to a proposal on the design for a repeatable environment we can pose anti-bot problems to and get reliable analysis out of.

Building that environment out over the following months so that, by month six, we can point it at a target or provider and have it reliably tell us how we're being blocked and what is and isn't being used against us.

Your responsibilities

Analyse how specific anti-bot and bot-mitigation systems (the likes of DataDome, Cloudflare Turnstile, Kasada, PerimeterX and Akamai) detect and block us, and design systems to work around them.

Turn isolated breakthroughs into durable, repeatable processes: hypothesis, test, discard what's wrong, move on.

In collaboration with other senior team members, design and build a greenfield agentic environment that can propose and run tests on anti-bot behaviour and bypass approaches, and do it in a way that's well understood and repeatable.

Work largely independently on deep, concentrated problems, while actively pulling in knowledge from across the wider engineering team.

Communicate clearly what you plan to do, and step into major incidents when the team needs your depth.

What you bring to the table

Deep, genuine understanding of how the internet works underneath: HTTP, TLS and fingerprinting, proxies, headers, cookies, and browser behaviour. This is the core of the role and it isn't something we can shortcut.

Enable and configure partner-sourced methodology content and audit procedures within the platform, ensuring audit standards are translated into usable, platform-ready workflows

Integrate and structure guidance from US GAAS, PCAOB standard

jobs.title: Contract Sr Data Analyst (SQL,Telemetry,Browser Engine)
jobs.description:
The Gecko platform is the core engine of our product experience. To maintain competitiveness and user satisfaction, we must move beyond surface-level metrics to understand the deep correlations between engine performance and real-world user behavior. We currently face challenges with data quality, such as bot contamination in nightly telemetry, which obscures our understanding of true performance trends. A dedicated analyst is required to bridge the gap between engineering telemetry and actionable product strategy, ensuring that leadership has high-fidelity data to prioritize performance guardrails and technical budgets.

Engineering Deliverables

  • Automated Dashboards: Create and maintain high-level overview dashboards that translate complex performance data into consumable formats for Product Managers and leadership.
  • Telemetry Gap Analysis: Audit the Gecko codebase to identify missing collection points or "probes" necessary for a complete understanding of the product experience.
  • Data Sanitization Frameworks: Develop methodologies and tools to identify and filter data inconsistencies, specifically focusing on isolating bot traffic and hardware-specific noise from telemetry streams.
  • Behavioral Inference Reports: Deliver deep-dive analyses correlating technical performance shifts (e.g., LCP, eTLD+1) with user-facing pain points and engagement trends.

Scope, Skills, and Effort Estimate

Scope

The analyst will focus exclusively on Gecko engine telemetry across multiple platforms (Desktop and Android), collaborating with the Performance Team, Data Team, and Product Leadership.

Required Skills

  • Technical: Advanced SQL (BigQuery/Redash), proficiency in data visualization using AI tooling, and experience with statistical analysis (e.g., Pearson’s correlation, multivariate analysis). Knowledge of Rust/C++ is a strong plus. Strong proficiency with AI tools like Claude Code, Codex, or similar is highly desirable.
  • Domain Knowledge: Ability to understand browser component interactions and their impact on user experience.
  • Soft Skills: Proven ability to work independently, translating technical requirements into business insights.

We’re not your average benefits platform – we’re the driving force that uplifts people’s lives. Our technology connects the entire benefits ecosystem, creating better outcomes for employers, employees, brokers, and providers.  Our mission is clear: to build a world where everything works at its best, ensuring every employee gets the support they need to thrive—both at work and beyond.

Your Mission

As our  Software Engineer (Data) , you’ll build and run the pipelines, orchestration, and infrastructure that move data across Ben: in from our product and the tools we use, in from our customers, and back out to them again. WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN US

Work on a civilisation-scale problem  - Clean, baseload fusion energy is one of the few genuinely world-changing challenges, and every hire directly accelerates the path to a working stellarator.

Grow as fast as the company does  - With headcount set to roughly 5x in a few years and major technical milestones ahead on the path to our demo machine and first power plant, your role grows under you; today's hire is tomorrow's function lead.

Tackle problems that don't exist elsewhere  - Fusion sits at a rare intersection of deep-tech R&D, industrial procurement, government relations, and venture financing, so non-tech functions face challenges no other workplace can offer.

YOUR IMPACT  As our Senior Security Engineer in Munich, you will own security implementation and security monitoring, digital and physical, for a company building one of the most valuable bodies of fusion IP in Europe. Protecting it is its own challenge, and you are the person who will own it.

•

Build out our security monitoring capability: select and run the SIEM, decide what's worth alerting on, and tune out the noise.  •

Own incident response end-to-end, from investigation through to a post-mortem and a fix that holds.  •

Harden the environment hands-on across endpoint and EDR, identity and access, network, and infrastructure.  •

Finish maturing Zero Trust: identity and device posture as joint conditions for access, and MFA everywhere.  •

Handle the long tail of edge cases that comes with a fast-growing team and a lot of contractors.  •

Secure our Google-centric workplace, where most of our IP moves — DLP, data classification and labeling, retention, and context-aware access.  •

Secure the software supply chain in collaboration with our platform team: source control, access boundaries, secrets, and CI/CD.  •

Run vulnerability and attack surface management, and drive remediation to be done with the teams that own the systems.  •

About BSI

BSI Merch & Artist Services runs design, supply, fulfilment and e-commerce for artists and their labels and management. We build and run official artist web stores on Shopify for the UK and EU, ship from our warehouses in Leamington Spa and Berlin, and support album campaigns from pre-order through to release week, for artists including Franz Ferdinand, Kneecap, Frank Turner and We Are Palace.

Every order through those stores is a fan buying something from an artist they care about. Customer Services is where that relationship is won or lost.

The Role

You'll answer customers across our artist stores, resolve order, delivery and returns issues end to end, and feed what you learn back to the wider e-commerce team so problems get fixed at the source.

What we are looking for  You bring professional experience in customer service, clear communication skills, and a practical approach to resolving support requests in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Customer support

Respond to customer tickets by email and chat through Gorgias, across multiple artist stores and in each store's tone.

Handle order queries end to end: tracking, delivery delays, address changes, missing items, pre-order dates and cancellations.

Manage returns, exchanges, refunds and reships, including damaged and faulty items, collecting photo evidence and processing returns through Loop Returns.

Resolve complaints fairly and within our service standards (acknowledgement within 2 working days, resolution within 14 calendar days), escalating to the CS Lead where needed.

Apply UK and EU consumer rights correctly, including the 14-day cancellation period and its exceptions.

Working with the wider team

Chase stock and fulfilment issues with the warehouse and Product team, and flag anything that needs a reship or a hold on stock.

Raise patterns early to the Head of Customer Service and/or relevant department

Housekeeping and reporting

Keep the queue clean: tag tickets accurately, close spam and auto-replies, and keep macros and Help Centre articles up to date where required.

Log refunds, reships, common issues and recurring problems so they feed into the monthly CS report for each client.

Help maintain and improve the AI Agent's guidance and the CS Help Centre for new stores.

Launches and release weeks

Our workload follows the music. A store launch, a pre-sale or an album release can bring hundreds of tickets in a few days, and the questions shift with each stage of the campaign.

Pre-order and pre-access:  questions about access codes, dispatch dates and what's included in bundles.

Release week:  high volume around delivery timing, signed items and chart-eligible bundles, where getting media to customers on time matters.

After release:  returns, damaged items, missing parcels and reship requests.

You'll need to stay calm and accurate under pressure, prioritise the tickets that matter most, and occasionally flex your hours around a launch.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Web + Infrastructure)
jobs.description:
Searoutes makes the emissions data that shippers use to run and reduce their
logistics. It is an operational problem before it is an environmental one, and
in our hands it is mostly an engineering one.

We are hiring a  senior engineer  who works across our web frontend and our
infrastructure — the same two codebases, in the same week. Someone who ships a
product screen on Monday, changes an identity-provider flow on Wednesday, and
considers those the same job.

We are looking for a broad profile rather than a specialist. The next year is
mostly platform work with a user-facing edge —  user management, API gateway

management, payments, SEO, and a great deal of compliance, GDPR and ISO 27001.

If you are passionate about the environment, proactive and pragmatic in getting
things done, and love to work in a complex but fascinating industry where you
learn every day — then this is the place for you.

The work in front of us

Some of the items on our tech roadmap for the coming year. Bets are picked a
cycle at a time and shared out, so you would take the ones that suit you and
grow into the rest.

Product and marketing UI in React  — multi-brand, WCAG AA, strong on
technical SEO, fast enough to hold a performance budget.

User management and identity  — Keycloak realms, organisation hierarchies,
partner brokering, and the entitlement model in the app.

API gateway work in APISIX  — routes, plugins and auth policy as code.

Payments and billing.

ISO 27001 and GDPR  — access control, change management, audit logging,
observability and alerting, consent and retention.

The infrastructure underneath  — Pulumi in TypeScript, Docker Swarm on
Hetzner, Cloudflare at the edge, Tailscale for all engineer and CI access.

Third-party integrations  — usually the seam between two systems that were
never designed to meet.

Nobody arrives fluent in all of that, and we are not expecting it. We want
someone strong across a good part of it, comfortable being new to the rest, and
used to working things out — with a team and with agents, rather than alone.

Also in daily use: Postgres and PostGIS, Valkey, ClickHouse; Vite, Tailwind and
Radix; Jest and Playwright; GitHub Actions; HAProxy. Most of what we write is
TypeScript, strict — though our core API is Java and Spring, and the identity
layer has Java in it too, so how far you go into that side is up to you.

How we work

LLM-native, in the codebases you would work in.  They are built around
agent-assisted development rather than merely tolerant of it — the conventions,
the tooling and the review gates all assume it. Agents do most of the
implementation and much of the review; humans design, verify and approve. What
we are really hiring for is  judgement over output you did not write by hand :
knowing what to specify, what to check, and what to throw away. The bar did not
move when the tooling did.

Shape Up, and you own what you take.  Roughly three weeks of building, then a
week of cooldown, with bets chosen at a b

Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios responsible for developing 2K’s portfolio of world-class games across multiple platforms, include Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber, 31st Union, and HB Studios. Our portfolio of titles is expanding due to our global strategic plan, building and acquiring exciting studios whose content continues to inspire all of us! 2K publishes titles in today’s most popular gaming genres, including sports, shooters, action, role-playing, strategy, casual, and family entertainment.

Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, thinkers and doers, are the professional publishing stewards of our growing library of critically-acclaimed franchises such as NBA 2K, 2K PGA, Battleborn, BioShock, Borderlands, The Quarry, The Darkness, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization, Marvel’s Midnight Suns, WWE 2K, and XCOM.

At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work! We encourage ALL applicants to explore our global positions, even if they don’t meet every requirement for the role. If you're interested in the job and think you have what it takes to work at 2K, we encourage you to apply!

What We Need

We’re looking for a highly analytical and strategic thinker to join our team as a Manager, Commercial Strategy. In this role, you’ll help define the strategy behind how our games are launched, monetized, and supported over time. This is a 0-to-1 role. You won't be inheriting a mature P&L and tuning it at the margins, instead you'll be defining the commercial model from the ground up: designing the monetization framework, building the forecasting models, standing up the KPIs and dashboards, and partnering closely with product and design as we move between development milestones toward a global launch and ongoing live operations. If you’re the kind of person who enjoys diving into data, building business cases, and translating insights into clear, actionable plans, then this is a great opportunity!

You'll sit at the intersection of product, design, marketing, data analytics, and finance, and you'll be the person who connects the dots between "what's good for the player" to "what's good for the business."

What You Will Do

  • Modeling & Business Case Development: Build and maintain Excel-based financial and strategic models to support business cases, investment decisions, and scenario planning
  • KPI Frameworks & Forecasting: Create and deliver forecast and reporting packages

jobs.description:
About the role

At Agile Robots, we build powerful software frameworks to orchestrate complex robotic systems and solve challenging tasks. The solutions are sold to various international customers to enable them to control their robotic work cells. Smooth integration and scalable deployment are key goals.

AgileCore is meant to be a scalable platform that supports multiple projects in parallel. That only works if the platform underneath scales with it - if it stays fast, thread-safe, and diagnosable as projects, devices, and operating conditions multiply.

We are looking for a Senior C++ Performance Engineer to join our AgileCore Runtime core team. This is a T-shaped role in a small senior team: you are a full member of the core team first - contributing to the Runtime, reviewing contributions from the teams that build on our platform, and sharing our support and release duties - and within the team, you own the performance and stability practice as your specialization.

On the specialization side, you will drive the performance of the Runtime core - the Blackboard, the Behavior Engine and the execution paths beneath them - make the system provably thread-safe under load, and make failures in the field fast to diagnose. You own the practice: the methodology, the tooling, the benchmarks, the audits and the education. You work hand in hand with the platform architect, who owns the performance budgets and hot-path interface contracts at the architecture level - you turn those budgets into measured, enforced reality and shape them with your findings. You set the standard for performance, concurrency and troubleshooting, and raise the team's ability to meet it without slowing feature development down. This is a shipping role, not a research role: success is measured in merged improvements, closed field escalations and green regression gates - not in microbenchmark leaderboards. We optimize to the budget the product needs, not to zero.

  • Greenfield performance infrastructure: the benchmark suites, budgets and CI regression gates are yours to build, not inherit

jobs.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

Based in France, the France Account Executive will be responsible for growing Planets Government sales pipeline and book of business in the Ministère des Armées and the Armées Françaises. The ideal candidate for this position is a driven, independent thinker, who can also be creative in finding new and dynamic ways to expand Planet’s government business. This person will have a proven track record of selling in government and defense, with an extensive network and able to navigate procurement processes and frameworks. They will identify, qualify, negotiate, and close large and medium-size deals and drive sales revenue targets. Most likely, the ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Military Operations and Intelligence as well as designing, forming and selling complex solutions to government customers.

This role involves developing an extensive pipeline of new sales leads, providing product and sales demonstrations to prospective customers, and formulating appropriate business. To support this, the France D&I Account Executive should have the ability to forecast accurately when managing the incoming pipeline of opportunities. The need to source, sell, co-sell, and close deals means that the ideal candidate should be familiar with the concepts of solution selling, carrying quota and closing. Above all else, we want our potential Government Sales Executive to enjoy our unique value proposition and join us in Planet’s mission to see change and change the world.

This is a full-time, remote position based in France. If located near an office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.

jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Wolt is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Front-end-leaning) to join our Operations Foundations team. The team sits within the DoorDash Client and AI Development group and is responsible for the foundation that hundreds of engineers across Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo rely on to build internal operations tools. Our platform hosts 250+ micro-frontends (MFEs) used to operate every part of the business.

Our team is focused on building a scalable, reliable, and high-quality internal tooling platform that supports Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo’s operations and business.

The team plays an important role in improving how engineers build, test, and ship software across the organization, with a strong emphasis on reusable libraries, micro-frontend architecture, and agentic development: building the platform where AI agents can take changes from task to merged PR safely and reliably without lowering the quality bar.

Currently, we are focused on unifying our frontend platforms, evolving shared components and library development, improving developer productivity, and enabling teams to deliver more independently through better architecture and tooling.

It’s an exciting time to join because the team has strong ownership and a broad technical impact.

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can take ownership of complex technical initiatives across both frontend and sometimes backend and infra domains. In this role, you’ll work primarily with TypeScript, React, Node.js, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Buildkite), and MFE architecture to build scalable, maintainable solutions that support multiple product teams and business areas.

Success in this role means becoming a trusted technical owner who consistently delivers reliable solutions and helps the team execute more effectively. Six months into the role, we’d expect you to be independently leading technical initiatives and contributing meaningfully to architecture and delivery planning.

Our backend  tech stack  consists primarily of Python Flask web apps with our  TaskTiger  scheduler handling many of the backend asynchronous task processing chores. We have a well-documented  public API  that is consumed by our front-end JavaScript app as well as numerous integrations. By identifying complex topological anomalies, detecting sophisticated rendering exploits, and programmatically analyzing mesh and animation data, you'll ensure our marketplace remains safe, highly performant, and visually stunning for hundreds of millions of users.

  • Detect Artifacts and Exploits: Develop programmatic, graphics-driven solutions to identify geometry-based exploits, malicious topologies, rendering hacks, and visual artifacts before they can impact the platform.

The Game Engine team at Roblox works on the systems that power the experiences at the heart of the metaverse. Our code is the technical foundation in our client, editor, and our simulation servers.

The Game Engine team is broadly split into departments — Audio-Video-Communication, Avatar, Core AI, Digital Matter, Productivity, and Systems. This position is for the Systems Runtime pod.

The Runtime pod builds and maintains the foundational C++ components that power the entire Roblox engine and Studio stack. We own the runtime layer — the performance, efficiency, and usability of the core primitives that every other engineering team relies on. Think of Runtime as the “standard library” and execution engine for Roblox's C++ world. Our ownership centers on three pillars:

  • Concurrency System — our task scheduler and fiber runtime power how work is parallelized across CPU cores, letting teams scale features across platforms while keeping code understandable and debuggable.
  • Memory System — we own the engine's memory allocator stack, tracking pipelines, and observability tooling to make memory behavior predictable and prevent leaks and fragmentation.
  • Profiling and Observability — we build and evolve the MicroProfiler and telemetry pipelines to help engineers diagnose real-world regressions and keep the client fast at global scale.

This role centers on our Concurrency system. You will own the scheduler and fiber runtime that the rest of the engine is built on, research and implement the performance work needed for 3K-player servers and genre expansion initiatives, and act as the point of contact other engine teams come to with concurrency asks. You will debug real production failures across PC, Mac, mobile, and console, and build deep intuition for how compilers, CPU architectures, and operating systems interact. QuantumDiamonds is building the world's first commercial quantum sensing tools for chip failure analysis. About us

EggAI is a fast-growing AI consulting and development startup. We build agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients. We are growing in several European markets.

The role

You will lead our clients through the organisational and operational changes needed to establish a shared AI platform. The platform has two parts: an AI Control Plane that governs what agents may do and records the evidence, and a managed AI Runtime where the agents run. Both integrate with the client's identity, security, delivery and audit services, and both need owners, approval routes and support arrangements on the client side.  You will own delivery outcomes from mobilisation through production release and operating handover, acting as the client sponsor's day-to-day counterpart. The role reaches across engineering, business leadership, security, risk, compliance and operations. You will bring these groups together to agree how the platform is governed and supported, and what evidence they need for assurance in a regulated environment.  You will lead an EggAI delivery team with a mix of Platform Engineering roles and skills. Client application teams develop the business use cases; you lead AI platform delivery and the changes needed for teams to adopt and operate it.

Why this role

Most organisations are still working out how to let AI agents act safely in production: who approves what an agent may do, how its actions are evidenced, and who answers when something goes wrong. There is no settled playbook yet, especially in regulated industries. In this role you will help write it. The operating models, approval routes and assurance practices you design with our clients will shape how they run agentic AI for years, and they will become the basis of how EggAI delivers across Europe.  You will work at the point where AI capability meets enterprise reality, with direct access to client sponsors and EggAI leadership, and with real influence over how a growing company builds its delivery practice.

About the role

We build the isolation layers that contain untrusted and semi-trusted code. You will design, build, and harden process sandboxes across one or more of Linux, macOS, and Windows, the last line of defense when something inside goes wrong. This is a deep systems role for someone who thinks in terms of attack surface, threat models, and the exact boundary between trusted and untrusted.

  • Design and implement sandboxes using platform primitives: nsjail, seccomp-bpf, namespaces, cgroups, and Landlock on Linux; the Seatbelt (sandbox_init / SBPL) and related mechanisms on macOS; AppContainer, job objects, restricted tokens, and integrity levels on Windows.

  • Make deliberate engineering tradeoffs between isolation strength, performance, compatibility, and maintainability, and document the reasoning.
  • Write threat models, review designs, and respond to sandbox escapes and hardening findings.

You Have:

  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of the OS security model on at least one of Linux, macOS, or Windows, and the sandboxing primitives that platform provides.
  • Strong grasp of attack surface analysis: how sandboxes are escaped and how to shrink the ways in.
  • Fluency in the boundary between sandbox and host (brokers, IPC, syscall filtering, privilege separation) and how to design a minimal, well-audited interface.
  • Systems programming in C, C++, or Rust; comfort at the syscall and kernel-interfac

  • Co-create User's multi-year people strategy - Work with group leadership to turn product strategy into an annual people plan and a multi-year talent roadmap covering capability gaps, succession, future skills, and where to invest

jobs.title: SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist – Technical SEO, Google Ads & Lead Generation | Remote

Position Type:  Full-Time, Remote

Working Hours:  U.S. Business Hours

Experience Level:  Mid-Level to Senior

Department:  Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced  SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist  to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth.  The ideal candidate has strong expertise in  technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation . This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies.  You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in  AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO) .

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Optimization

Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.  Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.  Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance.  Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data.  Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.  Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across  Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads .  Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).  Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels.  Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns.  Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals.

Content Marketing & Website Management

Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives.  Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages.  Manage website updates through  WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms .  Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience.

Analytics, Reporting & Optimization

Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using  Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager . UiPath’s Intelligence Document Processing drives understanding of the documents and messages on which a business runs: invoices, claims, contracts, customer emails. You'll be building the product that does it: the ingestion and extraction pipelines, the APIs customers build their operations on top of, and the systems that make those models useful, fast and trustworthy at enterprise scale. Work with engineers, product managers and customers to design, build and operate the AI systems behind UiPath's document processing products.

Build across the pipeline: ingestion, parsing and extraction, indexing and retrieval, and the evaluation that tells us any of it is working.

Take features from idea to production and stay with them, measuring whether they actually worked, and improving them when they didn't.

Solve genuinely hard problems in concurrency, latency and distributed systems, so the platform holds up under high-volume production workloads.

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Every dollar Anthropic earns and every dollar it spends on compute has to reach the books correctly, and the volume grows with Claude usage. That data comes from across the company and from partners: usage and billing, compute, infrastructure assets, leases. Products and pricing models keep launching, and each one adds another path into the books. Our goal is a continuous close with zero material issues, with audit-grade controls.

You’ll build the platform that gets us there: one front door for every finance event, an append-only ledger, and an accounting engine that posts each event exactly once. This is a distributed systems problem with an unusually high correctness bar. The system has to be right to the cent, replay cleanly and explain any number as of any date, at that volume. You will shape its architecture. Its users include Claude agents, which read and write through the same APIs and controls as people.

You’ll work closely with SWEs in Billing, Compute and Infra on shared contracts and APIs, and with product owners, finance operations and internal audit to turn accounting and controls requirements into designs. You don’t need a finance background. If you have built backend systems where correctness matters, we will teach you the domain.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build the front door into finance and its governed contracts: APIs for apps and agents, an event bus for systems that publish, adapters for vendor apps and reports, data-quality gates, and processing that posts every event exactly once, with replay and backfill
  • Drive the build of the accounting ledger and engine: an append-only ledger with idempotent posting, a rules framework that turns business events into journal entries, translation into the ERP, and period locks
  • Design and build the SDKs and frameworks that finance apps and agents build on
  • Build controls into the platform as code: immutable audit trail, maker-checker, scoped access and segregation of duties
  • Build and run the production services that other engineering teams call in real time, such as the tax and collections services in the billing flow, and own their reliability: uptime, latency, throughput and correctness targets agreed with those teams
  • Shape the platform’s technical direction: architecture, engineering standards and design reviews

Minimum qualifications

  • Strong backend engineering in a statically typed language such as Go, Jav

B2B sales experience.

3+ years of total sales experience in a closing role.

The VLA Core team builds the base vision-language-action model that the entire manipulation pipeline depends on. Run pre-, mid- and post-training on the VLA stack; explore new modalities and architecture changes.

Build video prediction and dynamics models that stay physically consistent over long horizons, including contact-rich manipulation, and serve as pretrained priors for VLA policies.

Develop learned-simulator evaluation: score candidate policies offline, predict real-world success rates before deployment, roll out policy futures for safety review and planning.

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

  • Expertise with SQL, Python, and big data technologies such as Spark or Databricks
  • Experience turning legal, policy, or regulatory language into precise metric definitions, documented well enough for someone else to audit
  • Hands-on work on transparency repor

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Chip Design RL
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the RL teams

Our Reinforcement Learning teams lead Anthropic's reinforcement learning research and development, playing a critical role in advancing our AI systems. We've contributed to all Claude models, with significant impacts on the autonomy and coding capabilities of Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Opus 5.5. Our work spans several key areas:

  • Developing systems that enable models to use computers effectively
  • Advancing code generation through reinforcement learning
  • Pioneering fundamental RL research for large language models
  • Building scalable RL infrastructure and training methodologies
  • Enhancing model reasoning capabilities

We collaborate closely with Anthropic's alignment and frontier red teams to ensure our systems are both capable and safe. We partner with the applied production training team to bring research innovations into deployed models, and are dedicated to implementing our research at scale. Our Reinforcement Learning teams sit at the intersection of cutting-edge research and engineering excellence, with a deep commitment to building high-quality, scalable systems that push the boundaries of what AI can accomplish.

About the role

We're hiring for the Code RL team within the RL organization. As a Research Engineer, you'll advance our models' ability to design silicon. Hardware design is difficult and unforgiving – exactly the sort of domain we want Claude to excel at.

You'll leverage your chip design expertise and turn it into tasks and signals for models to learn from. Specifically, you will:

jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ANALYTICS

What We Do

Our Data & Analytics teams build powerful stories and visuals that inform the games we make, the technology we develop, and business decisions that drive Epic.

What You'll Do

You will design, build, and optimize the recommendation systems that power Fortnite's Discover experience, serving personalized recommendations to one of the largest player bases in gaming across a massive catalog of creator-built experiences.

You'll work across the full recommendation stack: candidate generation, content ranking, impression allocation, and real-time reranking.

Unlike recommendation systems that operate over a stable catalog, you're working with a massive, rapidly changing content library where new experiences are published daily, quality signals are sparse, and the system's own outputs shape the data it learns from.

In this role, you will

  • Design and implement retrieval, ranking, and reranking models for creator content using deep learning approaches (two-tower architectures, transformer-based sequence models, embedding-based retrieval) and build the user representation systems that power personalized discovery
  • Build and optimize multi-stage candidate generation and impression allocation pipelines that balance relevance, diversity, and fair content exposure across a large and rapidly evolving catalog
  • Design and run A/B experiments to validate model improvements, own evaluation frameworks that capture recommendation quality holistically, and drive the path from experiment to production deployment
  • Collaborate with analytics and content quality teams on ranking signals including genre classification, creator credibility, and content quality metrics

  • 5+ years of experience building production recommendation or ranking systems, ideally in a UGC, marketplace, or content discovery context
  • Experience with deep learning for information retrieval and multi-stage recommendation pipelines (candidate generation, scoring, reranking)
