In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

That's where you come in.

As a Character Artist at Riot, you will bring champions to life by creating and texturing high and low poly models. You will help craft some of the most iconic characters in the world of gaming. Your sculpting skills, artistic eye and keen understanding of anatomy, form, and color will lead the way in character creation. Working within both technical and design constraints, you will use your knowledge of proportions, anatomy and readability to ensure models are optimized in game. Your craft expertise, high-level execution and attention to detail will enrich the player’s immersive experience.

As a 3D Character Artist on the Unpublished R&D Product, you will translate character concepts into game-ready assets that meet technical and design requirements. You will contribute throughout the character production process, from concept to final implementation, and collaborate with multiple disciplines and external partners to deliver consistently high-quality character assets. You will create appealing, distinctive, and readable characters that help deliver a high-quality player experience. You will report into the Art Director of the team.

Responsibilities:

  • Use your knowledge of stylized character art to create high-quality 3D character models.
  • Interpret and execute character concepts while considering technical and design constraints such as polygon counts, texture memory, and topology.
  • Understand the complete asset creation process, from concept design, modeling, baking, and texturing through successful integration into the game.
  • Review and provide guidance on character content created by external partners, helping maintain stylistic consistency, quality standards, and project budgets.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide.

What You’ll Do

We’re looking for a part-time Copywriter to join our team and support CRM communications. This role focuses on short-form, UX-driven copy across digital touchpoints, working closely with CRM, Creative, and Product to deliver clear, effective messaging. You will:

  • Write and iterate on short-form copy for CRM channels, including push notifications, email, and in-game messages
  • Create UX-focused microcopy for app and desktop experiences
  • Apply UX writing principles to improve clarity, usability, accessibility, and user understanding
  • Collaborate with CRM, Creative, Product and Marketing partners to align copy with user journeys and intent
  • Ensure consistent tone and quality across surfaces while adapting to different contexts
  • Iterate on copy based on feedback, testing, and performance insights

What We’re Looking For

  • Native English proficiency with extensive professional experience writing in English
  • Strong familiarity with UX writing principles; prior experience as a UX Writer is a significant plus
  • Proven experience with short-form digital content and microcopy (app or web)
  • Comfortable working within tight character limits and design constraints
  • Detail-oriented, collaborative, and open to iteration
  • Able to manage feedback and deliver high-quality copy in a part-time setup

Bonus Points

  • Experience working with CRM or product teams
  • Familiarity with A/B testing or data-informed copy optimization
  • Experience in gaming, mobile apps, or consumer tech

Please submit your CV in English.

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. jobs.title: Machine Learning Intern
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PROGRAMMING - EPIC RESEARCH

What We Do

Epic Research conducts state-of-the-art research in machine learning, AI, character animation, and digital humans. We work with leading universities and product teams to bring new research into games like Fortnite, Unreal Engine, MetaHuman, and the tools creators use every day.

MACHINE LEARNING RESEARCH INTERNSHIP AT EPIC GAMES

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for current PhD students and recent PhD graduates (within 12 months of graduation) for paid research internships, working on state-of-the-art machine learning across our ecosystem. Epic makes Unreal Engine, which powers creative work across many industries, alongside some of the world's most popular games, including Fortnite and Rocket League. Through these products, ML research at Epic reaches millions of creators and players every day. AI is reshaping the games industry, and Epic Research - led by Lucia Specia and Michael Black - is at the center of that shift. We're looking for talented interns who want to be part of it.

In this role, you will

Work with our team of research scientists and programmers at the intersection of vision, language, speech processing, embodied agents, and game development to create state-of-the-art machine learning models in a range of areas - research topics of interest include:

  • AI-backed interactive characters: LLMs for conversational characters, memory systems, automated evals, animation, etc.
  • Game agents: vision-language-action, game-state agents, etc.
  • 3D human and object tracking
  • Reinforcement learning for embodied behavior
  • Speech systems and conversational agents
  • World building and game logic generation: video models, 2D->3D scene building, etc.
  • AI-assisted game development, e.g. the next generation of Epic Developer Assistant for UE and UEFN
  • Embodied and physical intelligence including human-object interaction
  • Multi-modal diffusion models
  • Player safety: AI-alignment, content moderation, etc.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Sandboxing
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Every time Claude runs code, uses a computer, or works as an agent, it does so inside a sandbox. Our Sandboxing team builds the isolation layer behind that work. The same systems run the code Claude writes for users, the environments we train and evaluate models in, and the agents our customers deploy.

These workloads are untrusted by design, and there are a lot of them. Sandboxes need to start in milliseconds, hold up under adversarial code, and scale to a very large number of concurrent sessions. You will work at the boundary between the Linux kernel, virtualization, and the container ecosystem. You will partner with research, product, and security teams to make sure that safe and fast do not trade off against each other.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate the sandboxing infrastructure that runs untrusted, model-generated code and agent workloads at scale

  • Improve sandbox startup time, density, and throughput, including snapshot and restore, checkpointing, and warm pools

  • Strengthen isolation across compute, filesystem, and network, including egress controls and per-session credential handling

  • Investigate and fix performance, reliability, and security issues at the kernel, hypervisor, and container runtime level

  • Build the monitoring, tracing, and debugging tools that show where time and resources go inside a sandbox

  • Work with researchers to support reinforcement learning environments and evaluations that need fast, reproducible, isolated execution

  • Work with product and platform engineers to expose sandboxes as a dependable, well-designed capability for Claude products and customers

  • Partner with security teams to threat-model the platform and to test, harden, and respond to escape and abuse scenarios

  • Work with cloud providers on the hardware and platform features that our workloads depend on

  • Share knowledge on systems programming and Linux internals, and help set technical standards for the team

Minimum qualifications

  • Software engineering experience in Linux systems programming, kernel development, or another low-level area

  • Strong programming skills in at least one systems language such as Rust, C, C++, or Go

  • Working knowledge of virtualization or container isolation technologies such as KVM, QEMU, Firecracker, gVisor, or runc

  • Unde

jobs.title: Production Finance
jobs.description:
In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends and has since gone on to become the most played PC game in the world and a key driver of the dramatic growth of e-sports. At the core is the Global Content Services team, the group responsible for operating the major League of Legends, Valorant, TFT and other competitive international tournaments, defining global policies for the sport, driving global narratives, and providing services to our regional leagues. Our vision is to bring joy to billions of fans around the world by fostering a thriving global sport ecosystem. That’s where you come in.

Production Finance at Riot are responsible for processing and maintaining the financial data related to live events (e.g., esports) and other production related projects. As a Production Accountant on the Global Content Services team, you will be based in Korea to ensure local processes align with global standards while providing on-site financial support for live events.

You will report to the Sr Manager, Production Finance in Los Angeles.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide dedicated on-site production financial support for global and major regional events in APAC, acting as a direct finance partner to production teams to ensure seamless operations.
  • Collaborate and align with Global Content Services group to maintain a Vendor Rate Management system across a diverse network of vendors to standardize rate cards; Collaborate with regional PDs and prepare detailed production budgets per event in accordance with the production chart of accounts in a timely manner.
  • Maintain, track and report production expenses against budgets in real-time in financial systems and production tools to identify risks or savings opportunities.
  • Support post-event financial retro reports that tie detailed costs and core success metrics to provide key business insights to stakeholders.
  • Collaborate closely with regional PDs and stakeholders, sharing local insights to ensure financial decisions are aligned with the Global Content Services group.
  • Collaborate with Finance (Accounting, Tax, Purchasing, Treasury, T&E) to identify and escalate financial risk to the Global Content Services team.
  • Collaborate with Legal to identify and escalate local risks to the Global Content Services team.
  • Prepare ad-hoc reports including cost-benchmarking, year-over-year comparisons, and contract negotiations.

Required Qualifications:

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders, both internally and externally.
  • Bilingual (Korean and English) for seamless global collaboration.
  • Solid foundational knowledge of financial principles, with experience managing budgets, tracking costs, or performing financial analysis.
  • Self-starter with a solutions-oriented

jobs.title: Head of Customer Success
jobs.description:
At evenito, we build enterprise event management software centered on human connection. By combining cutting-edge technology with personal support, we empower event teams to automate routine logistics and free up time for what truly matters: crafting memorable, sustainable event experiences.  As our Head of Customer Success (CS) you will have a front row seat. Together with your team you will be responsible for evenito’s customer excellence. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will not only ensure that our customers receive professional support, but also be the strategic business owner of our post-sale organization and act as a key customer voice within the company. You will develop and execute a scalable CS operating model and play a pivotal role in shaping our product and the future of evenito.  Are you ready to make an impact?

Your Mission:

Drive customer success, develop a high-performing team and turn everyday user insights into strategic product growth.

Lead by Example:  You set the tone through your actions. From onboarding our largest enterprise clients (ICPs) to handling support tickets alongside your team, you showcase what great customer service looks like while equipping your team with the tools and support they need to succeed.

Team Development & Coaching:  You will lead and coach a team of five. Through regular 1-on-1s, clear goals and constructive feedback, you will foster a positive, supportive work environment focused on steady growth and a resilient team setup.

Escalations & Problem Solving:  You view complex situations as opportunities to build trust with our clients. When high-stakes issues arise, you partner directly with Product and Management to find clear solutions, using customer data to guide thoughtful decisions.

Cross-Functional Advocacy:  You serve as a key connector between our clients and internal teams. By sharing real customer insights with Product, Sales and Marketing, you help shape and prioritize our product roadmap while keeping team priorities aligned with company strategy.

Process & Project Innovation:  You stay current on Customer Success best practices and enjoy improving how things work. You will have the freedom to introduce new CS workflows that streamline daily operations and support our current growth stage.

Commercial Impact & Growth:  You ensure Customer Success is a growth engine by delivering clear, measurable value. You will drive product adoption and offer high-impact paid services, positioning expansions as a natural result of client success. This, while tracking performance with clear, business-focused metrics.

Knowledge Base Development:  You will own and champion our self-service tools (Knowledge Base, Video Academy, Automation). By making resources clear and accessible, you help our customers find quick answers independently and keep support queues manageable.

Your Story

You have a solid B2B SaaS experience, a practical doer mindset and a genuine drive to grow people and businesse

jobs.title: [HR Div.] Developer Relations Program 운영/지원 (3년 미만 / 계약직)
jobs.description:
우리는 게이머의 로망을 실현하기 위해, 누구도 가지 않는 길을 갑니다.
예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

KRAFTON은 각기 다른 크리에이티브 아이덴티티와 강점을 가진 약 20개 이상의 글로벌 스튜디오로 구성되어 있으며, 국내에만 14개의 스튜디오가 존재합니다. 다양한 위치에서 다양한 프로젝트를 진행하고 있지만, 우리는 모두 하나의 KRAFTON Family입니다.

KDC (KRAFTON Developers Connect)는 KRAFTON Family가 하나로 모일 수 있는 장으로, 서로 다른 배경과 경험을 가진 사람들이 교류하며 창의성(Creativity)을 더욱 발전시킬 수 있다고 믿습니다.

2011년 전사 차원의 지식 공유와 기술 교류를 목적으로 시작된 KDC는 지난 15년간 유관 업계 종사자, 전 세계 스튜디오 및 파트너들과 지속적으로 교류하며 범 크래프톤 차원의 연결을 확장해 왔습니다. KDC 팀은 KRAFTON의 다양한 신작 개발 및 독립 스튜디오 간의 '연결'을 통해 상호 이해를 증진시키고, 개발자 간 지식과 경험이 활발하게 유통될 수 있도록 커뮤니티를 설계하고 운영하는 역할을 합니다.

이를 위해 KDC 팀은 세미나, 핸즈온 워크숍, 해커톤, 직군별 밋업 등 다양한 형식의 프로그램을 기획·운영합니다. 단순히 보고 듣는 것을 넘어 경험을 공유하고, 인사이트를 얻으며, 의미 있는 네트워크를 형성할 수 있도록 — '인정 → 자극 → 동기부여 → 성장 → 새로운 기회'로 이어지는 크래프톤만의 선순환 개발 문화를 만들어가는 것이 우리의 목표입니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 해커톤 사전 준비 및 현장 운영 지원 (인쇄물 제작, 참여자 관리, 웹앱 데이터 입력, F&B·야간 지원, 설문 분석 등)
  • KDC Week·Club·Track 각 프로그램/행사별 사전 준비 및 현장 운영 지원 (연사 초청·예약 보조, 참가자 관리, 에셋 검수, 등록·세션 운영, 설문 분석 등)
  • 개발 행사 진행 전반의 현장 응대 및 사후 정리 (물품 반납, 사진 아카이빙, 재고·데이터 정리 등)

Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

As a Customer Support Specialist, you’ll help customers succeed with the Figma product suite, from individual designers to large enterprise teams. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

Join Anthropic's Customer Success team as one of the founding members of our Japan Customer Success team as we pioneer the future of enterprise AI adoption. As a Customer Success Manager at Anthropic, you'll be the strategic partner and trusted advisor to our most complex customers across Japan, helping them harness the full potential of all our Claude capabilities: API, Claude for Enterprise, and Claude Code.

You'll develop genuine partnerships with customers, gaining a deep understanding of their business objectives, strategic direction, AI vision, and technical needs. You'll draw on both your business acumen and technical expertise to serve as a strategic advisor throughout their journey with us.

In partnership with the broader account team, you will help customers identify the right Claude capabilities for their specific business objectives. You'll work closely with them to provide best practices and guidance, and support them as their usage (consumption and seat based) grows and evolves.

Your role focuses on helping customers scale their usage effectively, implement change management strategies, optimize use cases, and maximize the value of their investment through expanded use cases across their organization. The insights you gather from your customers will directly inform our research priorities, product development, and go-to-market strategies. That makes you a key voice in shaping how we build and deliver ongoing value as a business.

Build the software that turns ultrasonic inspection data into safety-critical pipeline decisions worldwide, and lift the team around you.

Location:  Utrecht region (head office in Tricht, Gelderland)

About Intero Integrity

Intero Integrity is an internationally operating specialist in the inspection, maintenance and emission monitoring of pipelines and industrial assets. We develop our inspection technology entirely in-house: from ultrasonic measurement systems and FPGA signal processing to the software our analysts use to interpret hundreds of kilometres of pipeline data.  The inspection results our software produces are used for safety-critical decisions about the integrity of pipelines and industrial installations such as heat exchangers. Reliability and correctness are therefore not a nice-to-have, but an absolute requirement.  We operate across Europe, North America and the Middle East. Our software products sit at the heart of that work: they are used every day by our data analysis organisation around the world. Whatever you build here has a direct, global impact.

The opportunity

This is a role for a senior engineer who enjoys both sides of the craft: building excellent software, and helping people around you get better. You will work hands-on on the C#/.NET software behind our data analysis, turning large volumes of ultrasonic inspection data into reliable insights that our organisation uses worldwide.  What makes it attractive is the mix. You mentor and guide our internal developers, setting an example in how we design, review and test. At the same time you work side by side with our external development partners. Learning from them, challenging them and making sure the work meets a high bar. You'll grow as an engineer and as a mentor, often in the same week.  Because our data is used for safety-critical decisions, a strong sense of software quality runs through the role: it shapes how you design, how you review and where you set the standard for the team. If you value knowledge transfer and a healthy engineering culture as much as writing good code, you will feel at home here.

What you will do

Hands-on software development

•

You design, build and maintain C# applications for the analysis and reporting of inspection data  •

You work with large volumes of ultrasonic signal data and binary data streams  •

You build web applications and REST APIs on the ASP.NET platform  •

You contribute to bringing machine learning / Human-in-the-Loop capabilities into the data analysis workflow  •

You work with cloud-native services, preferably on Azure  •

You contribute to test strategies at functional, integration and system level, with an eye for the safety-critical use of the software  •

You work closely with hardware engineers, test engineers and domain specialists (UT inspection)

You mentor and coach our internal developers and help them grow

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

How it works

Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.

Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.

Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.

Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

Requirements

2+ years of professional software engineering

Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)

Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++

Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing

Regular use of an AI coding tool

Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models

You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words

At least 10 hours a week, starting now

A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

Nice to have

Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure

Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

Terms

US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you

Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms

The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us

Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

jobs.title: Tabletop Exercise Lead, The Anthropic Institute
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Anthropic Institute

The Anthropic Institute (TAI) is a function within Anthropic that works to advance the public conversation around AI.

The Institute is comprised of research teams tackling some of AI's most consequential societal challenges: the Frontier Red Team, which stress tests our systems against catastrophic risks; Societal Impacts, which studies how Claude is used by millions of people; Economic Research, which tracks AI's impact on people's jobs and the larger economy; the Rule of Law team, which studies AI's impacts to democracy; and more.

The Institute's mission is to reduce information asymmetries between Anthropic and the outside world, name and answer the hard questions implied by powerful AI systems, and publish these findings so that policymakers, researchers, technology leaders, and the public can reckon with what's here and what's to come.

About the role

The role. You will build and lead the Institute’s tabletop exercise program and the team that runs it. Based on trends visible in the exponential and in consultation with technical experts, you will set the research agenda: which questions the exercises should answer, which scenarios to run, with which audiences, and what each run is meant to test. You will own the methods that make results comparable across runs and turn them into findings people outside the room can use. You will hire and manage a team plus a bench of facilitators, and you will be the program’s public voice.

Why tabletop exercises? If RSI arrives, the hardest problems will be about making decisions under uncertainty. The people making them may not trust each other, and the authorities they work under may not be fit-for-purpose. A tabletop exercise (TTX) allows the people who would face that situation practice it before it is real. It also shows us what tools and information they reach for, including what they would need that does not exist yet.

Tabletop exercises are also a research method. You can run the same scenario many times, with different groups of people (and with many more AI agents playing in silico), and you start to see the distribution of decisions people make. This is one of the few ways to generate empirical evidence about the future, i.e., how people and institutions will respond to situations that have not happened yet.

Key responsibilities

  • Set the program’s research agenda: the questions exercises should answer, the scenarios to run, and the audience for each

jobs.title: Research Intern, Frontier Speculative Decoding (Summer 2027)
jobs.description:
About the Role

The Speculative Decoding team at Together AI builds the draft models and algorithms that let large language models generate faster without changing their outputs. Our speculators run in production on frontier open models such as DeepSeek, Kimi and GLM. Our work sits at the intersection of model training, inference algorithms and serving systems, and we co-design all three to lower the cost and latency of generation.

As a research intern, you will dive into open questions in speculative decoding: new drafter architectures and verification schemes, knowledge distillation and training recipes that align draft and target models, and drafters that adapt as traffic shifts. You will train and fine-tune draft models at scale on dedicated GPU clusters, and test your ideas against realistic serving workloads, including long-context and agentic traffic.

Projects aim to answer important research questions in speculative decoding, enabling faster generation on frontier models, drafters that keep pace with changing workloads, and robust, reproducible evaluation under real traffic.

Past Research

Speculative decoding research by Together researchers, interns and academic collaborators includes:

  • Speculative Speculative Decoding (ICLR 2026)
  • When RL Meets Adaptive Speculative Training: A Unified Training-Serving System (ICML 2026)
  • Beat the Long Tail: Distribution-Aware Speculative Decoding for RL Training (MLSys 2026)

Responsibilities

  • Research and prototype new efficient speculative decoding algorithms and draft model architectures

You will be the main program lead for your location and own briefings end to end: qualification and intake, agenda design, speaker selection, and day-of execution. You will set the objectives and design for each agenda and develop it jointly with Sales. You will also be the local account teams' go-to partner on how to use a briefing to move their most important opportunities forward.

You will manage the global workstream and set the standard every center follows, so customers get the same quality of briefing wherever they meet us. This is a highly cross-functional role. You will work with regional GTM leadership and the Office of the CCO on account selection and program strategy, with Product Marketing on content, with Solutions on technical deep-dives and demos, with Anthropic's executive bench on sponsorship and participation, and with Workplace, Security, and Revenue Operations on the experience and systems behind every briefing. You will be comfortable running every part of a briefing yourself and maintaining tight alignment with internal stakeholders.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the Executive Briefing program at your location: the local calendar, capacity planning, the request and intake process from Sales, and operating SLAs, applied against global criteria and regional allocation
  • Work with regional GTM leadership to decide which strategic accounts receive a briefing each quarter, hold the qualification bar, and proactively surface accounts that should be engaged
  • Lead discovery with account teams before each briefing to understand the customer's objectives, business context, and stage of evaluation, and turn that into a tailored agenda
  • Own agenda design and co-own agenda development with Sales for every briefing, including the narrative arc, discussion topics, speakers, and demos
  • Build and manage the speaker bench for your location: identify, source, and match speakers to briefings, run prep, and manage capacity so no one is over-asked

jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PROGRAMMING - UNREAL ENGINE

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of programming experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

We're looking for a Principal Al Programmer who builds products that integrate Al into Unreal Engine. You'll design and ship the full stack of systems that let LLMs act inside the engine (from end to end, not just a single layer), bringing depth in game engine architecture, cloud services, and how LLMs actually work.

In this role, you will

  • Design and build LLM-driven agents and tools that operate directly inside Unreal Engine, including engine-side C++/Python tooling and editor scripting
  • Design and extend the cloud-hosted agent harness, services, and database that mediate between LLMs and the engine
  • Work across the full stack (engine tooling, cloud backend, and the web UI used to drive and monitor agents) to ship end-to-end features
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging LLM capabilities (tool use, multi-agent orchestration, context management) into Epic's engine and pipeline tooling
  • Define technical direction for the reliability, safety, and evaluation of LLM-driven engine automation
  • Partner closely with engine, tools, and backend programmers, and mentor others on both game engine internals and LLM system design

What we're looking for

  • Strong programming background with hands-on experience in a game engine (Unreal Engine strongly preferred), including engine architecture and tooling/editor scripting
  • Practical experience building or shipping products powered by LLMs (agents, tool-calling, RAG, prompt/context engineering), or a strong conceptual understanding of how LLMs work
  • Experience with cloud-native services and infrastructure: web APIs, databases, and service architecture and deployment
  • Excellent programming skills across C++ (engine-side) and Python and/or a web backend language
  • Experience in the games industry or equivalent, developing interactive entertainment products
  • Ability to work full-stack and reason about tradeoffs across engine code, backend services, a

jobs.description:
Scale AI’s customer-facing engineering organization is one of the fastest-growing and most technically demanding in enterprise AI. Frontier Agentic Engineers sit at the center of our most strategic relationships; building, integrating, and troubleshooting directly with customers. Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. 你将与游戏设计、美术、叙事、动画、工程等团队紧密合作。

主要职责

  • 负责游戏中音效的设计、制作与实现。

  • 主动根据玩家反馈、测试结果和团队反馈持续迭代。
  • 与外部作曲家、录音师、音频供应商等合作，并能够提供明确、有效的创作反馈。

任职要求

  • 具备成熟的游戏音效设计与制作能力，能够独立完成从概念到游戏内落地的完整流程。
  • 熟练使用主流 DAW 及声音设计工具，如 Pro Tools、Reaper、Nuendo、Ableton、iZotope 等。
  • 熟悉 Wwise / FMOD 等音频中间件，并具备实际游戏项目实施经验。
  • 理解游戏引擎中的音频工作方式，具备 Unreal、Unity 或其他商业/自研引擎经验。
  • 对Gameplay Feedback、声音层级、空间音频和交互式音频系统有深入理解。
  • 能够理解产品和设计目标，而不是仅从单一声音资产的品质出发进行设计。
  • 具备良好的跨职能沟通能力，能够清晰表达设计意图，并处理来自不同专业方向的反馈和分歧。

我们尤其看重

  • 能够从玩家体验而不是单纯从音频专业角度判断方案。
  • 能够解释自己的设计决策，而不仅仅依赖个人审美。
  • 面对设计、工程或制作限制时，能够找到体验、品质和成本之间的合理平衡。
  • 能够主动发现体验问题，并推动相关团队一起解决。

  • 모바일에 최적화된 인터페이스와 터치 기반 조작 시스템을 통해 손안에서 펼쳐지는 무한한 모험의 세계를 즐길 수 있도록 설계하려 합니다.
  • 원작의 방대한 오픈월드와 생존, 제작 시스템, 다양한 Pal과 함께하는 즐거움을 유지하면서도, 모바일 환경에 최적화된 플레이로 만들어 나갈 예정입니다.
  • Palworld Mobile에서만 경험할 수 있는 새로운 기능과 콘텐츠로 진일보된 게임 플레이 경험을 선사하고자 합니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 커뮤니티 등의 아웃 게임 시스템 디자인
  • 이벤트 시스템
  • 로그인, CDN, 운영툴 연동 등의 서비스 및 운영에 필요한 기능 기획
  • 업적, 퀘스트, 성장 등 기본 시스템 구현 및 개선 작업

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 최소 3년의 관련 게임 기획 경력
  • 원작 팰월드 플레이 경험이 50 시간 이상인 분
  • 기획 의도를 컨셉화하고 능동적으로 제안하며, 이미지/툴/데이터테이블 등으로 시스템 구조를 구체화하는 능력
  • 다양한 구성원들과 피드백을 주고받으며, 성장을 추구하시는 분
  • 모바일 플랫폼을 고려하여 UI/UX 기획이 가능하신 분
  • 해외 출장에 결격 사유가 없는 분

이런 경험들이 있다면 저희가 찾는 그 분입니다! (우대요건)

  • 팰월드 뿐만 아니라 러스트, 언던(모바일) 등의 생존 게임을 100 시간 이상 플레이한 경험
  • 이벤트 및 결제 시스템에 대한 업무 경험

크래프톤의 도전에 함께 하기 위해 아래의 전형 과정이 필요합니다.

  • 서류 전형 > 사전 인터뷰 (Phone Interview) > *과제 전형 > 인성검사 (Personality Assessment) > 직무면접 (Technical Fit Interview) > 종합면접 (2-3회) (Culture Fit Interview) > 합격 및 입사
  • *해당 절차는 각 포지션 및 후보자에 따라 변동이 있을 수 있습니다.
  • 상시 채용으로 채용 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
  • 필요 시, 인터뷰 및 직무 테스트가 추가될 수 있습니다.

This role reports to the Global Head of GTM Strategy & Operations, Frontier, and sits at the interface between GTM, Applied AI, Product, Research, Security & Safeguards, Finance, and Compute.

Run launches

  • Serve as GTM DRI for product and model launches: own account selection for pre-launch, coordinate field readiness across scaled pre- and post-sales teams, and run the launch-week operating room with extreme ownership.
  • Synthesize customer adoption signal (usage patterns, migration behavior, qualitative feedback from the field) into actionable reads for executive leadership across the company
  • Design and run the field response loop: how AE, CS, Applied AI and customer response and feedback gets captured, triaged, and routed to the teams who can act on it

Evolve the NPI methodology

  • Design and iterate GTM's NPI methodology across both standard releases and managed-access programs, including operating cadence, roles and handoffs with field teams, and the bar for launch readiness

Partner across the company

jobs.description:

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Anthropic's Business Risk & Insurance (BRI) team, part of Treasury, safeguards the company's balance sheet, people and physical assets. jobs.description:
About the Role

As Director of Investor Relations at Together, you will own the company's relationships with its investors and shape how the equity capital markets understand Together's business, strategy, and long-term opportunity. Reporting to the VP of FP&A, and partnering closely with the CEO, CFO, and executive team, you will be responsible for building our investor engagement strategy and investment narrative.

You will also own the core planning and reporting work that underpins our investor story: board reporting, the long-range plan, and the KPIs we use to run and describe the business. This hybrid investor relations and FP&A role will provide deep and unique insight into building and scaling an AI inference company.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role in a lean function: you will build investor relations at Together largely from the ground up. This role is well suited to someone with analytical rigor and a background in equity capital markets who follows developments in technology and AI closely. You will be responsible for deeply understanding investors' perspectives on Together as well as the broader industry, bringing strategic insights to leadership to help inform key decisions. Strong candidates pair depth in financial analysis with the ability to distill sophisticated financial and technical concepts into clear and concise investor narratives.

Responsibilities

Investor Relations

  • Serve as a key point of contact for Together's equity investors
  • Play a leading role in primary and secondary fundraising processes alongside the CFO and CEO, including building investor materials, running the data room and diligence process, coordinating investor meetings, and managing the process through close
  • Develop and sharpen Together's investment narrative, showing how our technology, business model, infrastructure footprint, and financial profile add up to a compelling long-term thesis
  • Build the reporting cadence and package for equity investors. Manage ongoing investor communications and requests, including regular investor reporting, ad hoc requests, and follow-ups
  • Advise leadership on investor sentiment, market expectations, and how key decisions are likely to be received
  • Develop a view of Together’s current and prospective shareholder base and how it should evolve, leading investor targeting and outreach accordingly
  • Prepare the CEO, CFO, and executive team for investor and board conversations by anticipating questions, sharpening key messages, and providing the supporting data
  • Track developments across AI, cloud infrastructure, and equity capital markets, including peer fundraises, valuations, and investor sentiment, and translate them into concise insight for leadership

Planning & Reporting

  • Own the quarterly board reporti

Anthropic is growing fast, and our SOX program needs to keep up. Many of the controls that matter for financial reporting run on engineering systems: who can access production and financial systems, how code changes are reviewed and deployed, and how usage is metered and billed.

We’re hiring a Technical Program Manager to own the technology side of our SOX program.   • Work with engineering teams to design and roll out IT general controls and IT application controls

  • Work with engineering teams to build Claude-based workflows, tools, and dashboards to automate evidence collection, control testing, and monitoring that warns engineering teams about compliance issues before an audit finds them

  • Lead large SOX projects, such as bringing new systems into scope, with clear success criteria, dependencies, and delivery dates

  • Turn control requirements into concrete engineering work with clear scope, owners, and deadlines, and a design that fits how our teams already build and ship

  • Track system migrations and scope changes, and make sure controls are updated as systems move

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer
jobs.description:
Scale is hiring a Staff Product Designer to lead product design for Scale's Public Sector business unit.

Public Sector brings AI-powered decision support directly to government and national security customers. You'll design sophisticated tools for critical operations including crisis planning, geo spatial- visualization, and human-agent collaborative canvases.

Much of this work has no established playbook. The conventions for how humans and agents plan, review, and decide together are still being written, and this role will help write them. You'll push past existing patterns to establish new ones, then make them durable enough for the rest of the platform to build on. This is a role for a designer who enjoys untangling dense workflows and making powerful systems feel coherent, intuitive, and trustworthy at speed.

What you’ll do

  • Own the end-to-end design, from undefined requirements through wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, and interactive prototypes.
  • Develop state-of-the-art techniques to leverage AI in design systems and processes.
  • Design for complex, data-dense workflows: dashboards, mapping interfaces, alerting systems, and analytical reporting tools.
  • Partner directly with Product and Engineering peers to turn ambiguity into clear product directions, work through tradeoffs and launch experiences.
  • Work directly in code alongside engineers, going beyond static mockups to help build and refine the shipped experience.
  • Work with customers, building direct relationships during key project touchpoints (discovery, feedback, post-launch) and confidently socializing design decisions with stakeholders.
  • Contribute design assets and interaction patterns back to the broader platform.

Who you are

  • 10–15 years of experience across a range of design settings and problem types.
  • You're energized by complexity. You take dense, tangled systems and turn them into something elegant and easy to use, and you're at your best when the problem is hard.

jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic’s Inference organization serves Claude to millions of users and enterprise customers, across our own products and the world’s largest cloud platforms, with the speed, reliability, and efficiency that frontier AI demands. The stack that makes this possible is deep and tightly coupled: accelerator kernels, an in-house inference engine that manages the entire token path for both production and research workloads, distributed routing, autoscaling, and capacity management. Every layer affects the others, often in ways that are hard to see in isolation. We build across GPUs, TPUs, and Trainium, and the complexity of building, testing, and shipping inference software grows with every platform we add.

We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to drive the programs that scale it. The work spans four closely coupled areas:

  • Scaling and infrastructure. Routing, autoscaling, and capacity management for the serving fleet, and bringing new capacity online.

  • Velocity. The toolchains, development environments, and CI/CD that let inference engineers build, test, and ship across every accelerator platform.

  • Inference engine. The software between the accelerator kernels and the routing layer that serves every request.

  • Performance. Improving throughput, latency, cost, and reliability across the stack, with correctness treated as part of performance.

This is not a status-tracking role. You'll own outcomes end to end, often where no single team is accountable for the whole picture. Much of your value comes from crossing boundaries into Research, Safeguards, Security, Compute, Infrastructure, API, and our cloud and silicon partners, and bringing back the requirements and dependencies that no team sees from inside its own space. There is little process to inherit, and we want to keep it that way: you'll build the minimum machinery the work needs and remove it when it stops helping. And because this is Anthropic, you'll have Claude as a collaborator. We expect TPMs on this team to push hard on what AI-assisted program management and fleet operations can look like.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the programs that scale Claude’s serving fleet across accelerator and cloud platforms, from early direction through delivery.

  • Drive new capacity online end to end, working across compute, infrastructure, security, n

Foundation Model Evaluation 팀은 우리 파운데이션 모델과 글로벌 프론티어 LLM을 다각도로 진단하여, 모델 개발의 방향성을 데이터에 기반해 제시하는 역할을 합니다. 벤치마크는 측정 축이 다양하고 점수만으로는 모델의 실질 역량을 판별하기 어렵기 때문에, 우리는 모델이 실제로 어디서 강하고 약한지를 깊이 있게 분석하고 그 결과를 모델 개선으로 연결하는 평가 체계를 구축합니다.

글로벌 프론티어가 주목하는 표준 벤치마크와 실제 사용 맥락을 반영한 자체 평가셋을 함께 운영하며 모델 동향을 추적합니다.

평가 결과를 모델·데이터팀과 공유하여 기술 로드맵과 데이터 전략 수립에 직접 기여합니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

Foundation Model Evaluation 팀의 Engineer로서 하게 될 일은 다음과 같습니다:

  • 우리 모델이 집중해야 할 역량과 타겟을 정의하여 모델 개발 전체의 방향성을 제시합니다.
  • 데이터 contamination에 영향을 받지 않고 모델의 실질 역량을 측정할 수 있는 신규 벤치마크를 설계·구축합니다.
  • 프론티어 모델과 우리 모델을 진단하여, 새로운 모델이 등장할 때 적합성을 빠르게 판단하고 기술 의사결정을 지원합니다.
  • 데이터·모델팀과 긴밀히 협업하여 데이터의 약점과 모델 설계의 개선점을 도출·전달합니다.
  • 대규모 평가를 안정적으로 실행·관리하는 평가 파이프라인·플랫폼을 개발하고, 평가 결과와 인사이트를 중앙화합니다.
  • 연구 성과를 Tech Report 또는 NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, ACL, EMNLP 등 탑티어 학회에 논문·워크숍 형태로 발표합니다.

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 딥러닝 관련 분야 전공 석/박사 졸업 이상 혹은 이에 준하는 연구 경력
  • AI 모델 평가·분석 또는 ML/NLP 토픽으로 AI/ML 탑티어 학회(NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, ACL, EMNLP 등) 논문 작성을 경험하신 분
  • 데이터를 하나하나 들여다보며 인사이트를 도출하는 집중력을 갖추신 분
  • 복잡한 실험 설정, 결과 분석을 명확하게 문서화하고 공유할 수 있는 커뮤니케이션 능력을 갖추신 분
  • 새로운 domain에 빠르게 적응할 수 있는 분
  • 원활하게 업무 커뮤니케이션 하실 수 있는 분
  • 해외 출장에 결격 사유가 없는 분

크래프톤 AX(AI Transformation)는 전사에 AI를 도입하여, 데이터와 인프라를 기반으로 임직원들의 워크(Work)와 워크플로우(Workflow) 자동화를 가속화하고 그 압도적인 효율화 성과를 전사로 확산하는 핵심 조직입니다.
Data Foundation 팀은 파편화된 전사 데이터를 통합하고, AI(LLM, AI Agent 등)가 즉각적으로 이해하고 활용할 수 있는 최적의 데이터 구조(Ontology)와 아키텍처를 설계·구축합니다.
크래프톤의 각 조직이 실제로 사용하는 데이터와 업무 맥락을 깊이 이해하고, 이를 AI가 이해할 수 있는 데이터 관리·활용 체계로 직접 기획하고 설계해 낼 분을 모십니다.

담당 도메인의 데이터 관리·활용 체계를 직접 기획·설계하고, 설계 산출물(Ontology 설계서, 데이터 모델, 거버넌스 기준 문서 등)을 주도적으로 작성·관리합니다.

  • 비즈니스 용어·지표 정의 및 데이터 거버넌스 기준 수립: 도메인별 핵심 용어(Glossary), 지표 정의, 데이터 오너십·접근 권한 기준을 현업과 협의해 수립하고 거버넌스 기준 문서로 정립
  • 데이터 품질·정합성 분석 및 개선: 원천 데이터의 정합성, 완결성, 중복 여부를 분석하고, 개선 방안을 직접 도출해 Ontology 설계 및 데이터 구축에 반영
  • 현업 부서와의 요구사항 분석 및 데이터 모델링: 담당 조직의 실무자를 인터뷰하고 업무 데이터를 분석하여, 실제 질의·분석 시나리오에 맞는 데이터 모델(테이블 구조, 관계, 계층)을 설계·구축하고 지속적으로 개선

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • SQL을 능숙하게 다루며, 원천 데이터를 스스로 탐색·분석해 구조를 파악할 수 있는 분

With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

Art Department 소개

Art Department는 크래프톤 게임 스튜디오의 아트 프로덕션 전반에 필요한 그래픽 기술과 솔루션을 지원하는 조직입니다. 그래픽 기술과 제작 파이프라인을 기반으로, 게임 개발팀이 빠르고 안정적으로 프로젝트를 시작하고 확장할 수 있도록 지원하며, 크래프톤만의 차별화된 아트 기술 서비스를 제공합니다
Art Dept는 “Scale-up the Creative”와 “AI-first”라는 회사 방향성 아래, 장인정신에 기반한 높은 퀄리티, 데이터 기반 최적화, 그리고 제작 효율화를 핵심 가치로 삼고 있습니다.
조직 구성원은 Advanced 그래픽 기술과 최신 트렌드를 선도하며, 전사 스튜디오를 대상으로 최적화된 제작 가이드라인을 제시하는 기술 파트너로서 역할을 수행합니다. 단순한 툴 지원을 넘어, 제작 과정에서 발생하는 기술적 병목을 선제적으로 해결하고, 스튜디오와의 협업(Co-development)을 통해 최상의 개발 경험을 제공합니다.
Art Department는 경험과 신뢰를 바탕으로 국내외 다양한 스튜디오를 지원하며, 지속적으로 성과를 만들어가고 있습니다. 크래프톤 게임이 높은 그래픽 완성도를 갖추고 성공적으로 시장에 출시될 수 있도록, 함께 성장할 전문가를 기다립니다.

Visual R&D 팀을 소개합니다.

About Anthropic

About the role

Anthropic is seeking a Director, Infrastructure Lease Accounting to lead technical accounting for our most complex infrastructure and energy arrangements — the data center leases and related structures underpinning our recently significant investment in American computing infrastructure. As we continue our rapid growth, you will ensure the financial statement accuracy of the most technically complex contracts we enter into.

This is an opportunity to be at the heart of one of the fastest-scaling companies in the industry, and to shape how Anthropic accounts for the highest-stakes arrangements underpinning our compute and energy portfolio.

You will serve as the technical accounting subject matter expert for arrangements spanning data center leases (ASC 842), and counterparty or joint-venture structures (ASC 810 VIE analysis). You'll work closely with Real Estate, Legal, Finance, and external auditors to ensure accounting implications are understood before commitments are made.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the technical accounting subject matter expert for Anthropic's most complex infrastructure arrangements, leading classification, measurement, and subsequent accounting judgments

  • Apply ASC 842 to complex lease arrangements, including lease identification, modifications, reassessments, and embedded leases within compute, colocation, and data center contracts

  • Apply ASC 810 to counterparty and joint-venture structures, including variable interest entity (VIE) analysis for special purpose entities

  • Apply ASC 815 to energy and infrastructure arrangements, including consideration of embedded derivatives

  • Lead technical accounting analysis and memo preparation for new arrangements, ensuring positions are well-reasoned, supported, and auditor-ready

  • Partner with Real Estate, Legal, and Finance teams during contract negotiation and execution to ensure accounting implications are understood before commitments are made

  • Serve as a trusted finance partner to non-finance stakeholders — explaining the financial statement impact of their decisions in clear, simple terms they can act on

  • Serve as a key point of contact with external auditors on technical accounting matters within your portfolio

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer: Compute
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

At Anthropic, we're building AI systems that are safe, beneficial, and transformative. Our mission is to develop AI that benefits humanity, and we believe the most powerful capabilities emerge when we thoughtfully bridge the gap between research breakthroughs and real-world applications.

Frontier AI runs on datacenters, and the world is in the middle of the largest infrastructure buildout in a generation. The binding constraint on progress is increasingly everything around the chips: land, power, permits, equipment, and the design and construction of the buildings themselves. Bringing a single site online involves hundreds of people, thousands of components, and decisions that move enormous amounts of capital. Much of that work still runs on spreadsheets and handoffs.

At Anthropic, we're building software and Claude-powered tools to help Anthropic scale out its compute, and we think there's an enormous opportunity to rethink how that work gets done. It's early, it's already having a real impact, and the engineers who join now will shape how one of the most consequential buildouts in the world gets done.

We're looking for strong, versatile software engineers who love building for people doing real work in the physical world. You'll embed with the teams that source sites, design buildings, procure equipment, and manage construction, learn their work deeply, and build the tools and systems they rely on every day. Datacenter experience is a big plus, but what matters most is that you can earn the trust of expert operators, model a messy domain cleanly, and move fast.

Responsibilities

  • Build the core systems that track a datacenter's lifecycle (sites, designs, bills of materials, equipment, and construction progress) in one trusted, permissioned source of truth
  • Embed with datacenter, energy, and supply chain teams to understand how the work actually gets done, find the critical path, and build the tools they reach for first
  • Bring order to messy data by migrating and reconciling spreadsheets and legacy trackers, and integrate with the industry's tools, like construction management, scheduling, and engineering systems
  • Design for trust: fine-grained permissions, auditability, and data quality for information that steers major investment decisions
  • Ship early, iterate with us

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Some of our world's grand challenges, from resolving long-open problems in mathematics to designing medicines for neglected diseases, require deep expert judgment that today's AI still lacks. We're working toward an AI scientist, a system capable of the long-horizon reasoning and experimental judgment needed to push the frontier on problems like these. About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About Beneficial Deployments

Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences — focusing on raising the floor for those who need it most.

About the Role

We're looking for an Applied AI Engineer to join our Beneficial Deployments, Life Sciences team. Our goal is for Claude to close the loop on scientific discovery, and a significant part of this is helping Claude to drive scientific hardware and software. You'll help deploy the Model Hardware Standard (MHS) to labs doing the world’s most important research. You’ll scale what you learn in the field by contributing back to the standard, building scalable assets, and driving associated internal product and research direction.

Responsibilities

  • Work with labs to automate their experiments end-to-end with Claude - from advising, to prototyping, to writing production code.
  • Drive product, engineering and research direction based on field experience - e.g. building evals to measure limitations of our models in the physical world (capabilities and safety), developing new features on MHS, etc.
  • Scale your impact to the long tail of labs through reusable cookbooks, documentation, and other assets.
  • Be an EMEA ambassador for Claude in the lab - you’ll both inspire and build trust with scientific audiences, from small settings to large conferences.
  • This role will require significant travel

You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have

  • Hands-on experience connecting software to lab robots and instruments (liquid handlers, plate readers, scheduling software, LIMS), ideally in an automated lab.
  • Strong engineering skills: you can take an LLM-powered tool from prototype to production code, and write evals to measure its performance.
  • A scientist's instinct for how experiments work: you can spot what's worth automating, and where AI might fail or be unsafe in the physical world.

Anthropic’s APAC go-to-market organisation is the fastest-growing part of our international business, spanning markets with distinct languages, cultures and buying styles. Today, enablement for the region is delivered by our global and EMEA teams. As we scale in APAC, we are establishing an initial in-region enablement presence, based in Sydney and supporting the field across the region.

As Enablement Lead, you will be hands-on in getting the APAC field ready: onboarding, ongoing skill development, manager coaching support and launch readiness, across GTM functions, not just sales. You will spend most of your time in the room, running sessions, building programmes and working directly with sellers and managers, in the time zones and languages where customer conversations happen.

This is a build role with a global spine. You inherit a working global and international enablement engine. Your job is to adapt it for APAC, deliver it across the region, and feed what you learn back into the international and global programme.

How we work: adults learn by doing, so we build sessions around live activity: practice, reflection, real customer scenarios. The measure is not what was covered in the room. It is what changes a week later in how people think, decide and sell.

This takes creativity and a solid understanding of how adults learn, applied at speed. The frontier moves quickly and the field is scaling fast. Much of the work is unlearning: helping experienced sellers let go of pre-AI habits, not just teaching new ones. AI is what makes this scalable: endless practice partners, personalised scenarios from real deals, feedback minutes after a call. You will use it that way, not to generate more content.

Key responsibilities

  • Set up the APAC enablement rhythm: in-region onboarding cohorts, live practice-based sessions in APAC time zones, and a feedback loop into the global programme
  • Adapt the international portfolio for APAC, where content for several markets needs to be written and translated ahead of delivery
  • Personally design and facilitate deal walkthroughs, role-plays and customer-conversation rehearsal, favouring practice over presentation
  • Partner with regional GTM leaders to build a coaching standard that scales as the manager layer grows
  • Own launch readiness for the region, so that when a new model or product ships, the APAC field is certified and conversation-ready in the same week cycle as everyone else

jobs.title: Senior Game Designer
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

DESIGN

What We Do

Put your design skills to work at a cutting-edge company that challenges the norm. From character and level design to competitive gameplay and system design, help shape the future of interactive entertainment at Epic.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a Senior Game Designer to help create compelling gameplay experiences across combat, progression, systems, moment-to-moment mechanics, and live gameplay content for our collaboration with LEGO. In this role, you’ll partner closely with design leadership, art, programming, animation, UX, audio, production, and QA to deliver high-quality features from concept through ship. You will own and iterate on gameplay systems, mechanics, and content while balancing player experience, readability, accessibility, engagement, and long-term retention. The ideal candidate is highly collaborative, deeply player-focused, and comfortable working in a fast-paced cross-disciplinary environment where iteration and feedback are core to development.

In this role, you will

  • Work in close collaboration with project leads & directors to design, prototype, tune, and ship features and systems that support the engagement, gameplay, and creative vision of the project
  • Document and create clear, actionable design documents, and iterate on these features, working with a team of developers across multiple disciplines, and oversee their successful implementation from start to finish
  • Get hands-on creating the scripting, data, and content required by those features, diving into the engine, and leveraging other tools
  • Be responsible for soliciting and rapidly integrating feedback from across the team on your own initiative, ensuring we’re continually delivering a fun and fresh experience to our players
  • Help establish and maintain design pipelines, best practices, and cross-discipline communication standards to scope, prioritize deliverables, and hit milestone goals

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of experience on a live service game, shipping a variety of different features and content types to react to changing player patterns
  • Strong scripting and technical capabilities. Bonus points if you have experience with Unreal Engine and the Ability System

jobs.title: Staff Applied AI/ML Scientist - Central Technology, Anti-Cheat
jobs.description:
Anti-Cheat is Riot’s first defense against cheaters that don’t want to play fair. As a cross-discipline team of former cheaters, kernel developers, machine learning engineers, data analysts, and software engineers, they make products like Vanguard to detect and ban the bad guys across all of Riot’s competitive titles and platforms, staying vigilant to whatever shape they’ll take in response. From beaming bots to scorching scripters, anti-cheat enables Riot’s game teams to take on competitive genres and design rewarding systems that would otherwise be too vulnerable to fraudsters and cheaters. Riot Machine Learning Engineers on Anti-Cheat are builders, trailblazers, and stewards of competitive integrity. We protect the legitimacy of Riot’s multiplayer games and player experience by building automated detection and decisioning systems to address a wide range of anticompetitive threats. As a Staff Applied AI/ML Scientist on Anti-Cheat, you will build machine learning driven detection systems to identify players engaging in cheating and other forms of abuse, and will develop agentic systems for reviewing and and actioning these players. You will partner with anti-cheat experts as well as game product, engineering, and insights teams to ensure that all Riot games afford safe, fair environments for players to compete and thrive. You will report to the Senior Manager of Anti-Cheat Data and Analytics.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, train, and deploy real-time machine learning models to detect gameplay anomalies, automated bots, and memory-tampering exploits.
  • Build scalable inference pipelines capable of evaluating millions of high-throughput game actions per second with minimal latency impact.
  • Partner with anti-cheat software engineers to identify emerging cheat techniques and engineer high-signal features from raw game client telemetry.
  • Establish robust ML Ops practices, including automated model retrain loops and continuous monitoring for adversarial drift.
  • Analyze complex, high-dimensional player data to minimize false positives and maintain a fair, competitive environment for players globally.
  • Work directly with game design and gameplay engineering teams to balance strict anti-cheat enforcement with smooth, responsive, and uninterrupted player experiences.
  • Collaborate with the data engineering team to troubleshoot and optimize ETL pipelines, ensuring efficient data flow and processing.
  • Help set technical direction within Anti-Cheat ML in an ever-evolving anti-cheat landscape

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 6+ years of experience delivering ML systems in production, including 3+ years in applied modeling or ML research roles.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Product Manager, Enterprise
jobs.description:
Role Summary

Scale is accelerating the development of AI across the world's most important organizations. The Forward Deployed PM is the person who makes enterprise deployments succeed from the product side — embedded with customers, shaping real production outcomes, and translating messy operational reality into high-signal input for the core platform.

This is not a roadmap PM, a CSM, or a solutions engineer. The FDPM owns product outcomes inside a portfolio of enterprise accounts: earning deep trust with senior customer stakeholders, driving deployments to production, identifying where the product is the bottleneck vs. execution, and feeding durable, specific signal back to the platform team. The best FDPMs have shipped products into large organizations and can tell the difference between a customer's stated request, their actual problem, and what the platform should do.

What You'll Do

  • Own product outcomes for our highest impact enterprise accounts. You are the accountable PM for product delivery and customer value.
  • Build trusted advisory relationships with VP/C-level buyers and senior technical leads. Become the reliable escalation point on the Scale side before issues surface externally.
  • Drive deployments from contract to production. You have done this before for large organizations. You know what 'production-ready' actually means and you close the gap.
  • Translate real customer workflows, friction, and priorities into high-signal product input for core platform teams. Not requirements docs — specific, evidence-backed product perspective with tradeoffs articulated.
  • Distinguish where the product is the constraint from where execution, integration, or change management is. Drive each type of blocker to resolution through the right channel.
  • Partner closely with FDEs so the account runs as a coordinated team, not a set of parallel workstreams.
  • Identify and develop expansion opportunities grounded in demonstrated customer value
  • Represent customer reality to platform and leadership with enough credibility that it changes decisions.

What We're Looking For

Core Competencies

  • Enterprise deployment ownership: has driven AI/ML or complex software products from contract to production at scale, with real integration, real security constraints, real change management.
  • Product judgment in the field: translates customer reality into product direction, not just feature requests; can say no credibly and explain why.
  • Customer trust-building: earns and maintains trust with demanding senior stakeholders over multi-quarter engagements; manages conflict without eroding the relationship.
  • Technical translation: bridges the gap between customer engineering teams and Scale platform engineers; does not relay messages, adds interpretation.<

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Public Sector

jobs.description:
The goal of a Machine Learning Engineer at Scale is to leverage techniques in the fields of generative AI, computer vision, reinforcement learning, and agentic AI to improve Scale's products and customer experience in production environments. Our machine learning engineers take advantage of robust internal infrastructure and unique access to massive datasets to deliver improvements to our customers.

Our Public Sector Machine Learning team is focused on deploying cutting-edge models to mission-critical government systems through products like Donovan and Thunderforge. Our work spans multiple modalities, with a strong focus on both large language models and computer vision. On the LLM side, we are developing agentic systems that help solve complex operational and planning challenges for government partners. This includes building agent frameworks that integrate with custom retrieval pipelines and production APIs, as well as evaluation tools to benchmark and refine agent behavior. We're also advancing research in areas like reinforcement learning for agentic LLMs, with successful deployment into real-world operational environments. On the computer vision front, we're training advanced models to increase labeling throughput and automate perception tasks. Our efforts include building large-scale fine-tuning pipelines, training models across multiple modalities, and developing generalizable vision foundation models to support a wide range of defense applications.

You will:

  • Take state of the art models developed internally and from the community, use them in production to solve problems for our customers and taskers
  • Improve and maintain production models through retraining, hyperparameter tuning, and architectural updates, while preserving core performance characteristics
  • Collaborate with product and research teams to identify and prototype ML-driven product enhancements, including for upcoming product lines
  • Work with massive datasets to develop both generic models as well as fine tune models for specific products
  • Build scalable machine learning infrastructure to automate and optimize our ML services
  • Serve as a cross-functional representative and advocate for machine learning techniques across engineering and product organizations
  • Be comfortable learning new technologies quickly and managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

This role will require an active TS security clearance

jobs.title: Machine Learning Fellow - Human Frontier Collective
jobs.description:
About the Collective

The Human Frontier Collective (HFC)’s mission is to bring the world's best minds to shape the future of AI – because the future of AI depends not only on powerful models, but on the people who teach them to think.
We bring together researchers, academics, and domain leaders across 70+ fields – over 90% of members hold doctorates – to shape how frontier AI systems are built, evaluated, and governed. HFC members have since co-authored published work including SciPredict, PropensityBench, and Professional Reasoning Benchmark.

Why join the HFC

HFC centers on three core pillars: the network itself, participation in selected AI/ML projects, and opportunities to publish with our research team.

  • Join a unique and exclusive expert network: You’ll become a part of an interdisciplinary community, consisting of over 90% doctorates and field leaders representing 70+ fields from the leading institutions. We’re a collective of top innovators and thought leaders committed to advancing frontier AI to power the world’s most important decisions.
  • Participate in AI/ML projects: Beyond the collective network, you’ll be regularly invited to work on high-impact projects with Scale AI and its affiliated lab and platform: building AI safety and policy guardrails, helping models understand real-world deep learning workflows by designing, reviewing, and optimizing PyTorch models, evaluating complex ML code and AI-generated implementations for efficiency and correctness, and more.
  • Co-author selected research publications: Collaborate with Scale’s research team to co-author technical reports and research papers—boosting your academic visibility and professional recognition.

Who should apply

  • Background: PhD, or postdoctoral research experience, in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related field; or senior industry experience in Machine Learning or a related field.

How it works

  • Duration: This is a fully remote opportunity with no fixed end date; engagements continue as long as there's mutual interest. This is a 1099 independent contractor engagement.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Research Scientist, Evaluations
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; New York, NY
jobs.description:
Scale works with the industry's leading AI labs to provide high quality data and accelerate progress in GenAI research. We are looking for Research Scientists and Research Engineers with expertise in LLM post-training (SFT, RLHF, reward modeling) and evaluation. This role is on the evaluation pod within the GenAI Research Organization and will focus on building benchmarks and diagnosing model failure modes in both text and multimodal modalities.

In this role, you will develop rigorous evaluations and diagnostic methods that reveal where frontier models fail and why. You will collaborate with researchers and engineers to define best practices in evaluation-driven AI development. You will also partner with top foundation model labs to translate failure analysis into technical and strategic input on the next generation of generative AI models.

You will:

  • Analyze model behavior to identify, characterize, and diagnose failure modes in frontier LLMs and Agents. You’ll identify everything from capability gaps and reasoning errors to robustness and alignment issues, all focusing on RCA.
  • Design and build benchmarks and evaluation methods that measure LLM capabilities in both text and multimodal modalities.
  • Apply post-training expertise (SFT, RLHF, reward modeling) to connect observed failures to the data and training interventions that address them.
  • Publish research findings in top-tier AI conferences.

Ideally you’d have:

  • Ph.D. or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or a related field.
  • Deep understanding of deep learning, reinforcement learning, and large-scale model fine-tuning.
  • Experience with post-training techniques such as RLHF, preference modeling, or instruction tuning, and with LLM evaluation or benchmark development.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Published research in areas of machine learning at major conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, CVPR, etc.) and/or journals.
  • Previous experience in a customer facing role.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Enterprise Core Platform
jobs.location: New York, NY; San Francisco, CA
jobs.description:
Role Summary

Scale is building the agentic operating system that powers AI deployment across the world's most important organizations. The Platform PM is the person who determines what that foundation needs to be — and holds the bar on how well it gets built.

This is not a roadmap PM, a program manager, or a feature tracker. The Platform PM owns the core infrastructure that every FD team builds on top of: defining the foundation before anything else can be built reliably, sequencing work against real customer commitments and FD team velocity, identifying which FD-built patterns are ready to graduate to core, and ensuring that every capability that ships does so at a bar customers can trust without thinking about it.

The best Platform PMs have defined platform capabilities at production bar in high-stakes environments and understand the difference between what is necessary to build, what is interesting to build, and what should never be built at all.

What You'll Do

  • Define the foundation. Determine what needs to be true at the core platform layer — across each capability pillar — before anything reliable can be built on top of it.
  • Sequence it. Prioritize and order platform work given customer commitments, FD team velocity needs, and what is actually blocking progress today. Getting this wrong means building on an unstable base or building the right things in the wrong order and paying for it in rework and FD team drag.
  • Identify patterns and graduate capabilities. Watch what FD teams are building across the application layer, determine what is genuinely repeating, and make the call on what moves to core — and when. Do not rush graduation or delay it out of caution.
  • Hold the quality bar. Every capability on the platform roadmap earns its place twice: once by being necessary, and again by being done well enough that customers trust it without thinking about it. Keep the platform from becoming a graveyard of half-built capabilities.
  • Unlock delivery team time to value. Forward deployed delivery teams should spend their time solving the hardest customer problems, not rebuilding plumbing on every engagement. That requires a platform that is secure by default, deployable anywhere, observable in production, and equipped with the agentic primitives, eval infrastructure, expert judgment capture, and data reasoning capabilities that every agent workload needs.
  • Partner across the organization. Work closely with platform engineering, forward deployed PMs, and BU leads to surface signal, resolve sequencing tradeoffs, and keep the roadmap grounded in what is actually blocking work.

What We're Looking For

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 6+ years in product management with meaningful time owning platform, infrastructure, or developer-facing products at production bar.
